items.title: Patch 1.0.21
items.contents:
A long list of tweaks and bug fixes incoming today! It touches on a little bit of everything, and we hope this patch will serve to give you all a smoother experience adventuring in Valheim.

[b]Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on.[/b]

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

[b]Bugs: [/b]
* Added a fix for being yeeted at high velocity when jumping on top of some enemies
* Snow storms in Deep North / Mountains and Ash storms in Ashlands no longer blow inside of your house
* Tree stumps in Deep North no longer sway in the wind
* Fixed vendor GUI not opening after having watched cinematic in the current session
* Fixed a bug where UI fields for names (World and Character) allowed non-name characters (e.g. ‘>’, ‘<’, ‘|’, etc - are no longer allowed). 
* Fixed bug where two trinkets could be equipped at once when dropping trinkets from itemstands
* Items no longer drop outside of inventory on mouse up
* Fixed issue where Kall Fimbulbringer’s drops could fall through the floor
* Fixed bug where the “No Skill Drain” status effect could get re-applied after the timer ran out
* Record correct crafter of item when Frost Foundry is network-owned by another player (achievement progress for crafting achievement is still tied to network owner, requires network incompatible update and is coming soon™)
* Fixed graphical seams in the ocean
* Fix a bunch of rare crashes, mostly in multiplayer
* Fixed bug that could cause Credits to show up on top of main menu GUI when exiting End Credits cinematic by pressing Space
* Fixed a bug where some achievements were incorrectly tied to the current difficulty level - Mighty Halls, Comfort is King, The Homesteader, The Architect, and The Survivor.
* Fixed a bug where you couldn’t filter Boss or Death markers with Gamepad

[b]Tweaks:[/b]
* Made Baked Poteitr, Kale Chips, and Oven Pancake craftable at Food Preparation table instead of Cauldron
* Correct tooltips are now used for uncooked Baked Poteitr, Kale Chips, and Oven Pancake
* Removed the ability for Wolf spirits to reproduce
* Removed requirement of moose trophies for upgrading DN mage helmet
* Gammeltroll Punch attacks can no longer destroy other petrified gammeltrolls
* Add Troll Trophy as requirement to The Trophy Collector achievement
* Make some previously indestructible props part of some locations destructible
* Make hood of the vanguard placeable on itemstand
* Make snow walls part of DN locations (e.g. village) easier to destroy
* Trees in Deep North now drop Timberwood cones, plant them in more hospitable biomes for a humongous tree (that also drops more Timberwood)
* Tweaked Timberwood drop rates, now drop fewer pinecones and more Timberwood
* Decrease Kall Fimbulbringer’s screen shake on some of his attacks
* Decrease Kall Fimbulbringer’s Yagluth Aspect’s Fire Nova DOT by half (ground fire)
* Nord Greatsword and variants no longer deal less damage per enemy when hitting several enemies in one hit
* Decreased volume of some base decoration fire sound effects – affects iron torch, sconce, and braziers. 
* Frozen Skeletons and Greydwarves no longer LOD out of existence super early
* Made moose colliders more accurate to the moose body
* Decreased Moose attack ranges somewhat

[b]Steam:[/b]
* Fixed an issue with save caching where file status can get out of sync when a world is modified outside of the game

[b]Xbox: [/b]
* Added a retroactive fix that cleans up character and world files with invalid names (e.g. “i<3” will be removed). Fixes critical bug that causes UI in main menu to disappear when selecting “Start Game”. 
* No longer show Gamepad association UI on startup

[b]PlayStation:[/b]
* Added info popup to when trying to join crossplay server while “PS5 only” toggle is on

[b]Switch 2: [/b]
* Fixed a bug where the Achievement details panel could not be scrolled via Touch

it.title: Patch 1.0.21
it.text:
Oggi è in arrivo una lunga lista di modifiche e correzioni di bug! Tocca un po' di tutto, e speriamo che questa patch serva a offrirvi un'esperienza più fluida mentre andate all'avventura in Valheim.
A causa di alcune limitazioni interne, la patch richiederà alcuni giorni per essere caricata su tutte le piattaforme. Nonostante questo, tuttavia, il crossplay rimarrà funzionante, così potrete continuare a giocare con i vostri amici a prescindere dalla piattaforma su cui vi trovate.
# Note della patch:
Bug:
• Risolto un problema per cui si veniva scaraventati ad altissima velocità saltando sopra alcuni nemici
• Le tempeste di neve in Deep North / Mountains e le tempeste di cenere in Ashlands non soffiano più all'interno della propria casa
• I ceppi degli alberi in Deep North non ondeggiano più con il vento
• Risolto un problema per cui la GUI del mercante non si apriva dopo aver guardato un filmato nella sessione corrente
• Risolto un bug per cui i campi dell'interfaccia per i nomi (World e Character) consentivano caratteri non validi per i nomi (ad es. ‘>’, ‘<’, ‘|’, ecc. - non sono più consentiti)
• Risolto un bug per cui era possibile equipaggiare due trinket contemporaneamente lasciando cadere trinket dagli itemstand
• Gli oggetti non vengono più rilasciati fuori dall'inventario al rilascio del tasto del mouse
• Risolto un problema per cui i drop di Kall Fimbulbringer potevano cadere attraverso il pavimento
• Risolto un bug per cui l'effetto di stato “No Skill Drain” poteva essere riapplicato dopo lo scadere del timer
• Ora viene registrato il corretto creatore dell'oggetto quando Frost Foundry appartiene via rete a un altro giocatore (il progresso per l'achievement di crafting è ancora legato al proprietario di rete, richiede un aggiornamento non compatibile a livello di rete e arriverà soon™)
• Risolte le linee di giunzione grafiche nell'oceano
• Risolta una serie di crash rari, principalmente in multigiocatore
• Risolto un bug che poteva far apparire i Credits sopra la GUI del menu principale uscendo dal filmato dei titoli di coda premendo Spazio
• Risolto un bug per cui alcuni achievement erano erroneamente legati al livello di difficoltà corrente: Mighty Halls, Comfort is King, The Homesteader, The Architect e The Survivor
• Risolto un bug per cui non era possibile filtrare gli indicatori Boss o Death con il Gamepad
Modifiche:
• Baked Poteitr, Kale Chips e Oven Pancake ora possono essere preparati al Food Preparation table anziché al Cauldron
• Ora vengono utilizzati i tooltip corretti per le versioni crude di Baked Poteitr, Kale Chips e Oven Pancake
• Rimossa la capacità di riprodursi per i Wolf spirits
• Rimosso il requisito dei trofei di alce per potenziare il DN mage helmet
• Gli attacchi Punch dei Gammeltroll non possono più distruggere altri gammeltroll pietrificati
• Aggiunto Troll Trophy come requisito per l'achievement The Trophy Collector
• Resi distruttibili alcuni elementi scenici in precedenza indistruttibili facenti parte di determinate location
• Reso possibile posizionare hood of the vanguard su itemstand
• Resi più facili da distruggere i muri di neve facenti parte delle location DN (ad es. village)
• Gli alberi in Deep North ora rilasciano pigne di Timberwood; piantatele in biomi più ospitali per ottenere un albero gigantesco (che rilascia anche più Timberwood)
• Modificate le percentuali di drop di Timberwood: ora rilasciano meno pigne e più Timberwood
• Ridotto lo screen shake di Kall Fimbulbringer su alcuni dei suoi attacchi
• Dimezzato il DoT di Fire Nova di Yagluth Aspect di Kall Fimbulbringer (fuoco a terra)
• La Nord Greatsword e le sue varianti non infliggono più meno danni per nemico quando colpiscono più nemici con un solo colpo
• Ridotto il volume di alcuni effetti sonori del fuoco per le decorazioni della base: interessa iron torch, sconce e braziers
• Frozen Skeletons e Greydwarves non spariscono più prematuramente a causa del LOD
• I collider dell'alce sono ora più precisi rispetto al corpo dell'alce
• Leggermente ridotto il raggio d'attacco dell'alce
Steam:
• Risolto un problema con la cache dei salvataggi per cui lo stato del file poteva desincronizzarsi quando un mondo veniva modificato all'esterno del gioco
Xbox:
• Aggiunta una correzione retroattiva che ripulisce i file dei personaggi e del mondo con nomi non validi (ad es. "i<3" verrà rimosso). Risolve un bug critico che causava la scomparsa dell'interfaccia nel menu principale selezionando "Start Game"
• Non viene più mostrata l'interfaccia di associazione del Gamepad all'avvio
PlayStation:
• Aggiunto un popup informativo quando si tenta di accedere a un server crossplay mentre l'opzione "PS5 only" è attiva
Switch 2:
• Risolto un bug per cui non era possibile scorrere il pannello dei dettagli degli Achievement tramite Touch

items.title: Patch 1.0.20
items.contents:
We've heard a lot of you pointing out that you haven't been getting as many trophies as you should from your kills, and this patch should finally fix that. We hope you're ready to craft those bear rugs!

[b]Please Note: There is a small delay with Mac App Store for this patch, which means that crossplay will not work between Mac App Store players and players on other platforms until it has caught up. As soon as the patch is out on that platform, crossplay should work for everyone again.[/b]

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

* Trophy drop chance is now increased by star level of monsters
* Pseudo-random drop logic will no longer be reset between player sessions to give a more fair distribution for rare drops
* Fixed a possible exploit to Forge of Potential
* Reset the cheated flag on all items and build pieces from previous versions, to undo the damage done by a bug in the initial 1.0 release that marked some validly obtained items as cheated.
* Fixed bug that caused Cheat Sword and Cheat Sledge to not be considered cheated in specific cases
* Fixed dedicated server running at uncapped frame rate if v-sync was enabled in client on the same computer, wasting massive amounts of CPU time
* Adjusted attachment points for sheathed weapons
* Xbox One/Xbox Series S|X: Fixed settings failing to save between sessions for some users

• Aggiustati i punti di aggancio per le armi riposte nel fodero.

it.title: Patch 1.0.20
it.text:
Abbiamo sentito che molti di voi hanno segnalato di non ricevere il numero di trofei che dovrebbero dalle proprie uccisioni, e questa patch dovrebbe finalmente risolvere il problema. Speriamo che siate pronti a craftare quei bear rug!
Nota bene: c'è un piccolo ritardo con il Mac App Store per questa patch, il che significa che il crossplay non funzionerà tra i giocatori su Mac App Store e i giocatori su altre piattaforme finché non sarà allineato. Non appena la patch sarà disponibile su quella piattaforma, il crossplay tornerà a funzionare per tutti.
# Note della patch:
• La probabilità di drop dei trofei ora aumenta in base al livello di stelle dei mostri
• La logica di drop pseudo-casuali non verrà più ripristinata tra le sessioni dei giocatori per garantire una distribuzione più equa dei drop rari
• Risolto un possibile exploit relativo alla Forge of Potential
• Ripristinato il flag cheated su tutti gli oggetti e pezzi di costruzione delle versioni precedenti, per annullare i danni causati da un bug nella versione 1.0 iniziale che contrassegnava come cheated alcuni oggetti ottenuti legittimamente
• Risolto un bug che faceva sì che la Cheat Sword e la Cheat Sledge non venissero considerate cheated in casi specifici
• Risolto un problema per cui il server dedicato girava a frame rate sbloccato se il v-sync era abilitato nel client sullo stesso computer, sprecando ingenti quantità di risorse della CPU
• Regolati i punti di aggancio per le armi riposte nel fodero
• Xbox One/Xbox Series S|X: Risolto un errore che impediva il salvataggio delle impostazioni tra le sessioni per alcuni utenti

items.title: Patch 1.0.17
items.contents:
A small bug fixing patch for today, vikings!

[b]Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on.[/b]

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

* Fixed a rare bug that could erase all objects in parts of the world when one large world save chunk file was split into smaller ones.
* Fixed invalid item types (most importantly invalid shield of root variant that was available in 1.0.15 on PlayStation®5) causing buggy behaviour. Now invalid styles just reset to the default style and continue functioning normally.
* Updated some placeholder text.
* Fixed credits being hidden in 1.0.16.
items.author: IronMontilyet
items.summary:
• Il crossplay rimane attivo tra tutte le piattaforme anche se l'aggiornamento richiederà alcuni giorni per tutti.
• Gli oggetti con stili non validi, come lo scudo di variante Root, vengono ora ripristinati allo stile predefinito.
• Risolti bug riguardanti la scomparsa di oggetti nei salvataggi del mondo, testi provvisori e crediti nascosti.

it.title: Patch 1.0.17
it.text:
Una piccola patch di correzione bug per oggi, vichinghi!
A causa di alcune limitazioni interne, saranno necessari alcuni giorni prima che la patch venga caricata su tutte le piattaforme. Ciononostante, il crossplay rimarrà comunque attivo, così potrete continuare a giocare con i vostri amici a prescindere dalla piattaforma utilizzata.
# Note della patch:
• Risolto un raro bug che poteva cancellare tutti gli oggetti in alcune parti del mondo quando un file di chunk di salvataggio del mondo di grandi dimensioni veniva suddiviso in file più piccoli.
• Risolto il problema con i tipi di oggetti non validi (in particolare la variante non valida di shield of root disponibile nella 1.0.15 su PlayStation®5) che causavano comportamenti anomali. Ora gli stili non validi vengono semplicemente reimpostati sullo stile predefinito e continuano a funzionare normalmente.
• Aggiornati alcuni testi segnaposto.
• Risolto il problema dei riconoscimenti che risultavano nascosti nella 1.0.16.

items.title: Word from the Devs: What a Month!
items.contents:
Greetings Vikings!

We can’t believe it’s only been a scant few weeks since we released 1.0. We’re so happy to see so many new and returning players alike, and we’re grateful for all the love you’ve shown us so far. Without you, we wouldn’t be here, so thank you!

We’re thrilled to say that we have even been nominated in as many as three categories for this year’s Golden Joystick Awards! You can [url=https://www.gamesradar.com/goldenjoystickawards/]vote for Valheim[/url] for Best Multiplayer Game, Best Indie Game and PC Game of the Year, and voting is open until October 23!

As you might have noticed, we’ve been putting out a bunch of bug fixing patches over the past weeks, and we will continue to do so, looking over both bugs and balancing tweaks. We thank you for your patience as we iron out all of the wrinkles, and if you do encounter a bug, please [url=https://valheim.com/support]make a report[/url] and we will take a look as soon as we are able.

In the wake of 1.0 we’ve also been dropping a bunch of other announcements on our social channels. In case you have missed one or some of them, we thought we’d sum them up for you in this post.

On the merch front, we’ve launched another [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heroicreplicas/valheim-winged-cloak-wooden-dice-tower]Kickstarter with Heroic Replicas[/url], where you can get your hands on cool new items like the Valkyrie blanket, or get a new chance to get a shield replica. We also have a new batch of [url=https://cantripcandles.com/products/official-valheim-scented-candle-3-set]scented candles with Cantrip Candles[/url], with the Meadows, Mistlands and Deep North joining the roster. Finally, we have announced a limited edition hoodie [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/valheim-hoodie]together with Makeship[/url], perfect as the weather is getting colder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/1bf4aeb53150d8f349fdb72e0c00bb8ac89cdbd6.png[/img]

We’ve also teased that Valheim is getting its own concert – one in Stockholm and one in Paris – next year. Tickets, as well as more cities, will be available soon, so if you’re interested you should [url=https://mailchi.mp/425906f1ab43/valheim-stockholm-paris-2027-sign-up]sign up to that mailing list[/url].

Another thing on the horizon for next year is that Valheim is entering the world of comic books! We have an absolutely incredible team working on bringing the tenth realm to the page, and we really hope you’ll like what they’re cooking up. On our website you will find some [url=https://valheim.com/comicbook]sneak peeks, as well as a link to sign up[/url] for more information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/5c116d4dcd13b5c70487b590aa4e4274459fc7e3.png[/img]

We suspect you might wonder what else is in store for Valheim. We can promise you that there are more content updates coming, though exactly what that content will be, we can’t reveal just yet. Simply rest assured that there is more in the works for Valheim, and we will be sure to announce it when we have news!

With that said, we also want to let you know that as 1.0 has been released, these Words from the Devs will no longer be monthly. Instead we will simply update you when we have news for you, and we hope you won’t miss us too much!

To sign off, we want to once again share the fantastic song and music video from Miracle of Sound – because Valheim really is about the stories that you have to tell, and about taking your fate into your own hands.

[previewyoutube=E_Lb7xrSvZI;full][/previewyoutube]

Skål!

/The Iron Gate team

[i]If you’d like to discuss the content of this post, please visit our Discord, or our forums on Reddit and Steam, or make a comment on social media! [/i]

items.title: Patch 1.0.16
items.contents:
Further tweaks for you today, vikings! This one includes fixes for both terrain modification and for some achievements, so we hope this makes playing smoother for you all!

[b]Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on.[/b]

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
* Fixed a bug that caused terrain modifications to revert in Deep North after unloading the area in some cases. Our apologies that this one went back and forth for a while! You may need to manually fix terrain seams by pickaxing, using the hoe, or walking over snow however.
* Fixed a bug that could cause way too many enemies to spawn, especially during raids
* Fixed Child of Odin achievement not unlocking correctly
* Fixed a case where Comfort is King achievement was not unlocking correctly
* Excluded unobtainable Blue Mushroom from The Gourmet achievement
* Fixed a bug where smoke from fires could push some enemies in unintended ways
* Fixed a bug where snow deposits from trees could cause the terrain to be raised around it
* Fixed a bug where certain spawns during the Deep North boss fight could spawn outside the boss area
* Fixed a bug where item variants were not applied visually to items on item/armour stands (e.g. shields)
* Updated localization 
* Placeable rocks and boulders no longer take rain damage
* Tessellation is now disabled in the “low” graphics preset
* Tree logs in Deep North now move more consistently when rolling over snow
* Fixed a bug where certain spawns during the Deep North boss fight could render incorrectly when standing in certain places
* Fixed an error / potential crash in the online session Player List
* Fixed a bug where rolling snowballs far away from the player could result in terrain seams and in some cases, crashes
* Switch 2 / PlayStation®5: Fixed a bug where motion controls activation was inconsistent
* Switch 2: Fixed a bug where banding artifacts could appear on textures of objects very close to the camera
* Mac App Store: Fixed a bug where backups could not be restored via Manage Saves menu

items.title: Patch 1.0.15
items.contents:
We have a small patch today that fixes an issue which has caused some players to have duplicated terrains and decreased performance. If you have been affected by this there is a possibility that you will have some visual seams in your terrain. Simply deform the terrain along these seams, or walk in the snow there to make the seams disappear. Previously, these seams would re-appear after reloading the area, but now they will persist correctly.

For those of you who have run into the issue of incorrectly having items marked as cheated: We have a planned fix for this, but as it’s a fix that has to be released simultaneously on all platforms as to not break crossplay, it will come in an upcoming patch. We just want to let you know that you can continue to play normally with these items and they will be fixed soon!

[b]Regarding lost levels on items:[/b]
An important message regarding the previous fix to where items on item stands or armour stands would lose their levels and variants. This was due to the updated save format introduced in 1.0, and sadly this data is lost in the conversion and the issue was not found during our testing of this update. This was fixed in Patch 1.0.12, so any world converted from now on will convert correctly.

The good news is that there is a workaround if you are affected by this, either:
* Revert your world from the backup which was made when you first loaded the new save format. [i]Note: All world progress & changes you have made in the world will be lost with this method.[/i]
* Or, make a copy of your backup, and enter into the backuped world, then put all your affected on to your character, and go back to your main world and replace the broken items.

If you need help with this please feel free to reach out to us in the support channel on Discord.

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
* Fixed an issue that could cause terrain duplications which resulted in a loss of performance
* Increased drop chance for Deep North Armor moulds by making both Jotun Warrior types drop both medium and heavy armor moulds
* Writhan spawn rate and areas increased
* Items affected by dev commands will no longer be marked for characters which have enabled the dev bypass command and naming has been updated and items can now stack together again


[b]Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on.[/b]

• Migliorate le prestazioni risolvendo un errore di duplicazione del terreno che causava rallentamenti di gioco.

items.title: Patch 1.0.14
items.contents:
We've got more hotfixes and improvements for you today! This patch touches upon a little bit of everything, from keybindings to music. We hope you're having fun in the tenth world, vikings!


[b]Due to some internal restrictions, the patch will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms. Despite this, however, crossplay will still remain functional, so you can keep playing with your friends regardless of what platform you’re on.[/b]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
* Added several new keybinding options to the keyboard (Alternate dodge key, hotbar rebinding (on top of 1-8), support for rebinding radial wheel, support for removing keybinds)
* Added accessibility setting to be able to toggle blocking
* Add toggle to Gameplay settings to skip the intro cinematic on startup
* When attacking, the player’s rotation now also snaps towards the intended attack direction when the “attack towards look direction” option is enabled, not just when it’s disabled.
* Swapped Motion Sensor and Sheath keybinds on gamepad, returning Sheath to its original keybind. Motion Sensor can now be activated with the alt-key + Sheath button instead.

[b]Optimizations:[/b]
* Improved GPU performance when tessellation is disabled by eliminating unnecessary GPU overhead in this case.
* Heightmap shadows are now calculated more accurately and at a lower performance cost.
* Optimized particle systems in the main menu to reduce overdraw.
* Multiple GPU performance improvements on Switch 2.

[b]Bugs & Issues:[/b]
* PlayerBase effect on some build pieces has been increased to block enemies more
* Fixed inaccuracies in stick input pre-processing that made it heavily weighted towards axis-aligned movement and 30% too slow diagonally.
* Jotun puffs and Magecaps no longer respawn.
* Fix for player characters sometimes mistakenly being marked as temporary cheaters, leading to items dropped by monsters they kill being incorrectly marked as having a cheated origin.
* Cheated stackable items no longer stack with regular items, preventing uncheated stacks from being “corrupted” into a cheated state. 
* Persistent Events devcommand (“pevents”) is now actually behind the devcommands toggle and not available in the console by default.
* Fixed errors when using the grappling hook’s secondary attack on creatures.
* Fixed various issues with Ashlands water (VFX, water damage not stopping)
* Fixed a bug where characters didn’t save correctly when manually pressing Save while playing on a server hosted by someone else.
* Disabled biomedata caching, fixing a bug where the cache could end up in an invalid state, making it impossible to join remote servers.
* Fixed Deep North battleaxes tool tier, can now cut all the trees.
* Made placeable boulders persist, only placeable on the ground, break if the ground they’re standing on goes away, and give ground-level support.
* Updated Ballista to make it accept all new trophies (All Deep North enemies + Bjorn + Vile)
* Timberwood build pieces no longer incorrectly show up in earlier biome locations
* Fixed various crashes/errors that could happen in rare circumstances
* Fixed a bug where Helmet of the Protector was craftable directly via the Black Forge
* Fixed a bug where terrain modifications by players or monsters could lead to performance and portal issues in multiplayer, such as performance and portaling issues, terrain seams, and terrain modifications becoming undone
* Updated Deep North and Winding Tunnels music for better balance and to remove some clicks when looping.
* Now plays the correct music in Mörkhalla.
* Better mixing of location music in the Deep North.
* Tweaked Seal and Baby Seal colliders to better match their bodies.
* Fixed an issue where the “No time for snoozing” achievement could sometimes not be unlocked in multiplayer
* Fixed an issue where The Homesteader and The Architect achievements could unlock repeatedly. 
* Nintendo Switch 2: The TV output no longer switches from 120 Hz to 60 Hz while the virtual keyboard is open or while in the home menu when using the balanced graphics preset and playing online multiplayer, which caused a black screen while entering and leaving these menus.
* PlayStation®5: The TV output no longer switches from 120 Hz to 60 Hz while in the home menu when using the balanced graphics preset, which caused a black screen when entering and leaving this menu.
* PlayStation®5: The “Stronger Together” achievement is now achievable.
* Steam: Fixed a bug where Steam Cloud could get stuck in an invalid state if the game crashed while saving.
items.author: IronMontilyet

items.title: Hotfix 1.0.10 & 1.0.12
items.contents:
[p]Hello vikings! We’ve got some hotfixes ready for you today, to facilitate your adventures in the tenth world. This includes a bunch of new sounds for the Deep North, and that you can now actually repair your endgame heavy armour. Phew!

We do also have some Steam specific fixes, which will arrive to all other platforms shortly as well. But not to worry – even though the fixes are Steam specific, crossplay between all platforms is still fully supported. The fixes include a function to let you opt into using achievements even though you have been blocked from doing so because of previous usage of devcommands. We will leave it to your own judgement whether or not to activate this function – Oden will surely know if you use it dishonourably.

May your axes stay sharp!

[b]We apologise for the delay with the patch for Switch 2, but now all platforms should be compatible for crossplay again![/b]

[h2]Patch 1.0.10 – All Platforms[/h2][p]* The heavy armour in Deep North can now be repaired
* Greydwarf Shamans in Deep North now deal appropriate amounts of damage and healing
* Punching no longer removes snow
* Landing on snow without directly walking now removes the snow
* Various sound effects updated for several creatures and the snow in Deep North

[/p][h2]Patch 1.0.12 – Steam Only[/h2][p][i]The following fixes are fully crossplay compatible and will be extended to all platforms in an upcoming hotfix, which we're pushing out as soon as possible.[/i]
* Using the Forge of Potential no longer unlocks recipes that should not be unlocked
* Items on armour stands and item stands no longer lose their durability & upgrade level IF the world has not yet been loaded in the 1.0 update (We are however looking into a better fix for this so do not remove high level items (fish, weapons, armour, etc) from your item stands without using backups if you have been playing 1.0!)
* Fixed a crash that could trigger when players tried to access a zone that wasn’t loaded
* Fixed a problem with banlist and whitelist that made them only compatible with new IDs (e.g. V_123456789) even though they should work with old IDs too (e.g. Steam_123456789)
* There is now a popup message to make it more clear when you can receive achievements again after them being temporarily disabled
* Achievements can be now be opted into even if you have used devcommands or mods by the new devcommand [spoiler]‘yesiuseddevcommandsbutiwantmyachievementsanyway’[/spoiler]
* It’s now easier to fit the Cart through the Timberwood Drawbridge
* Jotun Puffs and Magecaps no longer look pickable when they have been picked
[/p]

items.title: Word from the Devs: Almost there…
items.contents:
Greetings vikings!

We hope you’re having a wonderful summer! We’re currently gearing up for the 1.0 release in September, fixing some final bugs and getting everything ready for you to experience in just a few weeks. We hope you’re as excited as we are!

In the meantime, please do make sure you check out our [url=https://valheim.com/support/valheim-1-0-faq]1.0 FAQ[/url], which covers many of the questions we have been asked about the release. As always, we recommend that you start a new playthrough to get the best possible Valheim experience, but we also understand that many of you will want to visit the Deep North as soon as you can, and we have tried to answer any questions relating to that!

And one last time in case you missed it, the 1.0 announcement trailer:

[previewyoutube=eWULkdcaR5o;full][/previewyoutube]

As you know, next week we will be at Gamescom in Cologne, and we really hope to see some of you there. If you’re visiting, make sure to stop by our booth in hall 10 and say hello! And regardless if you’re there or not, make sure to keep an eye out for a brand new trailer that will be premiering during the event. We will be seeing some familiar faces…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/69290aebe219a4a96e89f7de6496d525f450c5db.jpg[/img]

And with that, we’ll see you on the other side of 1.0!

[h3]Build of the Month[/h3]

For many years now, we have been sharing your wonderful and creative buildings under this headline. With the Early Access journey coming to an end, we will also be wrapping up this particular segment – though we will of course still be curious to see what it is you’re building in the game. Keep an eye out on our social channels, because you can be certain that we will be asking you to share what you’ve made!

To round off, we will highlight two builds this time. First out is The Bridge by [url=https://discord.com/channels/391142601740517377/1532198787190358186/1532198787190358186]Hi, I'm Klaus[/url]. Look at all those creative solutions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/c9b7cd4ab4d100fc54e0b99601e92bc9cd51df01.png[/img]

And last, but not least, we want to direct your attention to the Cathedral of the All-Father, built by [url=https://discord.com/channels/391142601740517377/1531684242436788304/1531684242436788304]Ayriv[/url]. Since we’ll be going to Cologne it feels only fitting, after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/ab5222af43cc594b19f3d0f215bba5012e4ac73f.jpg[/img]

Sharpen your axes and raise your shields!

/The Iron Gate team

[i]If you’d like to discuss the content of this post, please visit our Discord, or our forums on Reddit and Steam, or make a comment on social media! [/i]

items.title: Word From the Devs: See You Soon!
items.contents:
Hello vikings!

What a month June has been! We were finally able to reveal our [url=https://valheim.com/news/valheim-has-a-release-date-]1.0 release date[/url] at the PC Gaming Show earlier this month, and we’re delighted that so many of you seem excited for the launch! At last it is official that Valheim 1.0, with Deep North and all, releases on the 9th of September this year, with full crossplay between platforms. If you missed it, or if you just can’t get enough of it, you can watch the trailer right here:

[previewyoutube=eWULkdcaR5o;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re very excited for you to be able to experience what we’ve been working on, and we really hope that you’ll have a great time!

Leading up to the launch, we can also reveal that we will have a booth at the Gamescom showfloor in August. If you’ll be at the event in Cologne, make sure to come find us for a chance to chat to some of the devs, and to experience Valheim in a more immersive way than ever before. We look forward to seeing you there, it’s gonna be big!

Another thing we want to make sure you don’t miss is our [url=https://www.makeship.com/shop/valheim]current Makehip campaign[/url]. Just like with the Rocky plushie last year, you have a limited time to get your hands on three brand new and unique Valheim plushies; the Valkyrie, the Serpent and the Jumbo Troll. They won’t be available after the campaign, so now’s your chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/43bbf50f0ec39463e30e8b80616c75ff48f15c22.jpg[/img]

[h3]Build of the Month[/h3]

This month we want to highlight the Snowspire Citadel, by [url=https://discord.com/channels/391142601740517377/1510250553333121146/1510250553333121146]xiaoming[/url]. Impressive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/35c12b2f3ac098f26737e64df784c2413a971ab0.png[/img]

If you want your creation to be featured in this section, use the hashtag #ValheimBotM on social media. Please also send us a DM or email with a link to your post, to make sure that we see it. Now you can also submit builds on Discord, by posting in the build-of-the-month forum channel! No DM is necessary if you post there, as that’s our own forum.

Skål!

/The Iron Gate team

items.title: Tell Us Your Valheim Story!
items.contents:
[p]Vikings! As Valheim nears its 1.0 release, we are looking to feature stories of our community members and fans who have played the game. Over the years we’ve heard many stories about players finding new friends, a welcoming community and even love through the game, and we’d love to highlight these tales of kinship and comraderie.

Whether you played when the game initially released or you’re playing every week to this day, whether you’ve reunited with your friends through Valheim or found your future spouse in the Tenth Realm, we’d love to hear from you!

If you’d like to share your personal Valheim Journey, we encourage you to record a video in which you describe your experience and submit it for a potential feature in an upcoming video piece that we’re putting together. You can do so below - don’t worry, it doesn't need to be a professionally shot video!

Submit your video [url="https://forms.gle/nPUimmunfrKs7y9K7"]here[/url]. [/p]
items.author: IronMontilyet

items.title: Valheim Has A Release Date!
items.contents:
Vikings!

For a long time you have asked when we will see the release of the Deep North, and at last we have a date to offer you!

Valheim 1.0 will arrive on 9 September, with new enemies to kill, bases to build and weapons to craft. The release will hit PC, Linux, Mac, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S as per usual, and now we’re also adding PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2 to the roster. Of course there will be full crossplay between all the platforms, so that you can play with your friends.

Thank you for being with us on this journey thus far, and stay tuned for more information as we get closer to the release!

For now, please enjoy the release date reveal trailer:

[previewyoutube=eWULkdcaR5o;full][/previewyoutube]

Skål!
/The Iron Gate team

items.title: Word From the Devs: Summoning Our Champions!
items.contents:
Hello vikings!

We would like to start off on a slightly different note this month, where instead of us sharing something with you, we want to ask you to share something with us. We are entering the final stages of development for the Deep North, and for Valheim 1.0, and for that launch to be the best it possibly can be we are in need of your help! There is currently a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/892970/view/508485755865137730]patch out on the PTB[/url] that features a rework of the save system, and we would be eternally grateful if you wanted to switch over to the PTB and test it out. What we would ask you to be particularly attentive to is any issues with your savedata or with the network functionality – if you find any issues pertaining to this (or any other bugs, of course) please [url=https://valheim.com/support]report them in our official form[/url]. Thank you most kindly!

On the topic of sharing, we also want to hear about your experiences of Valheim as a whole! Over the years we have received so many stories about people finding friends, community and love through the game, and we want to highlight these tales of kinship and joy. If you would like to tell us about what Valheim has meant to you, we encourage you to record a short video and submit it via [url=https://forms.gle/3VJresZvjiYEtMBg8]this form[/url]. It doesn’t have to look professional by any means, just follow the specifications listed in the form. Most importantly, tell us your story!

Of course we’re not only asking things of you this month, we also have some things to share on our end! First of all we want to let you all know to tune in to the [url=https://www.pcgamingshow.com/]PC Gaming Show[/url] on 7 June, as there might be something pretty interesting happening there from a Valheim point of view. You won’t want to miss it!

Another thing we want to share with you is the proper first look at some of the achievements that will be featured with Valheim at the 1.0 release! You’ve been asking for achievements for a long time, and we’re happy to say that there will be over 50 of them. We won’t tell you what you need to do to acquire them just quite yet, but perhaps you can make a guess or two?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/1b19de932d591bcf4aa5a47917e63b4dff11b1e7.png[/img]

items.contents:
[quote]⚠️ Note: [b]This update is for the Public Test branch of Valheim only, and may therefore be unstable![/b]

Prior to launching this update to the Default version of the game, we want to have a chance to discover bugs and fine-tune the balancing to ensure the best game experience.

[list][*][b]ACCESS[/b]: Right-click Valheim in your Steam library, then select ‘Properties’. In the new window, select ‘Betas’ and type in the code “[spoiler]yesimadebackups[/spoiler]”. The Public Test branch should now be available for you to select. The PTB FAQ can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/892970/discussions/0/3589961352692129408/]here[/url].

[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: Please leave any feedback in the “#valheim-public-test” channel in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com:/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/valheim/]Discord[/url] or through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com:/linkfilter/?url=https://valheim.com/support/]form on our website[/url].

[/list]Please remember to [b]be considerate[/b] towards players who are not participating in the Public Test, as some may prefer to avoid spoilers. As indicated by the access code, please ensure to create backups of your save files before playing.[/quote]

In this update we’re introducing a new save system for your Valheim worlds! The purpose of this is to make the game save faster, and to decrease the risk of corrupt save files. What the new system means in practice is that the game now saves your world in smaller chunks, and only the chunks that have been modified since the last save will be affected. Worlds will no longer be saved with a .db and a .fwl file, but will instead be saved and stored in separate folders, with the .db file broken down into smaller pieces. Backups will also have their own separate folders. Please note that if you intend to switch between the PTB and the Live branch of the game, it is not advisory to move your files around manually.

If this sounds overly technical, don’t worry – unless you’re frequently moving your files around manually, you won’t notice any difference beyond faster saving times!

For users who are running Valheim with mods, please note that this system has not been tested with mods. While we don’t believe there should be any issues relating to this, modding the game is always done at your own risk.

[h3]Detailed Patch Notes:[/h3]

* Introducing a new world save system
* The new save system only affects world saves, character saves remain the same.
* When saving, only the chunks that have been modified are saved.
* Instead of saving a world with the .db and .fwl files it’s now stored in folders and the world (.db) is split up in multiple files (chunks).
* Backups are stored in separate folders.
* When loading a world that is not chunked, a backup is made first so no data is lost in case of potential new bugs.
* The save system performs extra checks after saving to make sure it saved properly, which reduces the risk of a corrupt save.
* There is a new limitation in cloud storage, up until now it was only the total size of all saves. Some platforms have a limit in how many files can be saved, this was previously not a limitation but now there will be way more files saved.

items.title: Word From the Devs: Yeah, That’s A Drawbridge
items.contents:
Hello vikings!

We began this month of April, as is customary, with a bit of a laugh. Most of you caught on to the fact that it was an April Fools joke, but we do want to make sure to clarify that there is not going to be an additional game mode in Valheim where you can romance all the bosses, as fun as that might have been. Who had the most charming dialogue options? Who had the most romantic ending? We shall never know.

We also want to thank the team behind [url=https://www.val-con.org/]Val-Con[/url] for organising their event for the second time! Thank you for taking the time to bring the community together and celebrating Valheim! Our very own Robin Eyre and Jonathan Smårs featured during the event, as well as some of our friends from other companies who have helped us make the game, so make sure to check out their interviews in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ValConEvent/streams]VOD[/url].

But now, onto some teasers! Last month we asked if you had any guesses as to what one might be able to cook in the Deep North, and many of you guessed it: Meatballs with lingonberries, of course! They’re just one item on the menu of this biome though, because you’ll need plenty of food to sustain yourselves through adventures out in the cold:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/01f31c19e55dea1912a1019f70fd0bafdeb3f1ac.png[/img]

We’ve already hinted at some build pieces that will be coming to Valheim, but now we want to reveal perhaps one of the most impressive pieces yet. You have asked for a drawbridge for quite some time, and we are happy to finally be able to offer you one. Let the building commence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/c6f9f4c225067dd652df03e6bf81eabab8f97679.png[/img]

[h3]Build of the Month[/h3]

Speaking of building, this month we would like to shine some light upon this swamp village by [url=https://discord.com/channels/391142601740517377/1491590462161551510/1491590462161551510]RegretfulDesire[/url]! So many nice little details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/8fd66cd7c5fb91016228fe8e46b35ab29af7c930.png[/img]

If you want your creation to be featured in this section, use the hashtag #ValheimBotM on social media. Please also send us a DM or email with a link to your post, to make sure that we see it. Now you can also submit builds on Discord, by posting in the build-of-the-month forum channel! No DM is necessary if you post there, as that’s our own forum.

Skål!

/The Iron Gate team

[i]If you’d like to discuss the content of this post, please visit our Discord, or our forums on Reddit and Steam, or make a comment on social media![/i]

items.title: Word From the Devs: Winter Adventures
items.contents:
Hello Vikings!

While the story of Hervor Bloodtooth has come to an end, the same cannot be said for the Deep North. We continue to work away on crafting the biome, and today we want to show you a couple of different wintery snippets of what to expect, before spring is properly upon us!

First out, we want to show perhaps one of our most Swedish aspects of the biome – the lingonberries. They can be found and harvested in the woods, and used in several of the biome’s food recipes. Got any guesses as to what you might be able to cook?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/9945ae424047e96c65883b6c383356b066df5189.png[/img]

When it’s cold and snowy, one thing to always watch out for is slippery ice. The Deep North will be no different, and careless vikings might easily find themselves stumbling to catch their balance:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/1ee9127153bea17b6e13fdb8236e3829b15e8930.png[/img]

And in the Deep North, there will of course also be deep snow! This will need to be cleared if you want to settle down and build a base somewhere, but fortunately you can craft a shovel for this very purpose. Best put your back into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/cfb31e0063f21c6f575e64081160be3e03974960.png[/img]

These are just a few of the things we’re working on at the moment, and we’re happy to say that the biome is shaping up to something we really think you will enjoy.

Speaking of you, our brilliant community, it’s almost time for the second edition of the fan-run, online community event [url=https://www.val-con.org/]Val-Con[/url]!  It takes place in the middle of April, and there are a whole bunch of fun activities scheduled. This year, Iron Gate is officially participating, and we’re happy to pitch in with some fun prizes for the competitions and raffles during the event. You will also see some guest appearances from the Valheim development team, so stay tuned for that!

[h3]Build of the Month[/h3]

This month we want to shine a light on “Reed’s Hollow” by [url=https://discord.com/channels/391142601740517377/1480197232027500634/1480197232027500634]Leif[/url]. We love the creative use of the Elder altar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/fbf4a7783395404c7b769aa46c46a3e2a2a3c11d.jpg[/img]

If you want your creation to be featured in this section, use the hashtag #ValheimBotM on social media. Please also send us a DM or email with a link to your post, to make sure that we see it. Now you can also submit builds on Discord, by posting in the build-of-the-month forum channel! No DM is necessary if you post there, as that’s our own forum.

Stay warm!
/The Iron Gate team

[i]If you’d like to discuss the content of this post, please visit our Discord, or our forums on Reddit and Steam, or make a comment on social media![/i]

items.title: Word From the Devs: Looking to the Future
items.contents:
Hello Vikings!

First of all, thank you for all the kind messages during our five year anniversary earlier this month. We wouldn’t be here without all of you!

You might also have noticed that we announced that Valheim is coming to [url=https://valheim.com/news/valheim-is-coming-to-switch-2-]Nintendo Switch 2[/url] later this year! We’re really excited for this, and as usual we’re very thankful to have Piktiv helping us out with the port. Please note that the release will only be for Nintendo Switch 2, and not for the first Nintendo Switch console. More information about the release will come in time, but for now you can [url=https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/Valheim-3017687.html?srsltid=AfmBOoqxd5pPGNg_qNmNYa_sjIl272bhQy2gru-AtYEDkMg-WQAK2NTL]wishlist the game on the Nintendo eShop[/url].

With these two milestones behind us we also want to share with you the final part of the Voyage of Hervor Bloodtooth:

[previewyoutube=XBcZAJBwJgc;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, it must be said that Hervor’s story took place quite a long time ago, in a Deep North that’s a little bit different from the biome that you will explore yourselves, but perhaps there might still be some traces left of her for you to find…

One thing that will still remain standing despite the passage of time is of course the massive structure that marks the end of Hervor’s journey. What lies beyond this gate shall remain a mystery for all but the truly worthy, however.

[spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/0221db54b074b6e05ec35f12010223c5acc5ba67.png[/img][/spoiler]

And while this marks the end of Hervor’s story, we will of course keep having further teasers in our Words from the Devs in the months to come, rest assured! The Deep North continues to take shape with every passing day, and we really look forward to sharing it with you all once it’s ready.

[h3]Build of the Month[/h3]

It was particularly hard to choose a build to highlight this month, you have been busy! In the end, we want to shine the spotlight on “Eikthyr’s Pedestal” by [url=https://discord.com/channels/391142601740517377/1467776141703250064/1467776141703250064]Porter[/url]. Well done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33695701/05232ba5375caf27466f5763c1a63bdc3aecc109.jpg[/img]

If you want your creation to be featured in this section, use the hashtag #ValheimBotM on social media. Please also send us a DM or email with a link to your post, to make sure that we see it. Now you can also submit builds on Discord, by posting in the build-of-the-month forum channel! No DM is necessary if you post there, as that’s our own forum.

Skål!

/The Iron Gate team

items.title: Patch 0.221.12
items.contents:
We've got a couple of fixes for you today!

Please also note that playing using Vulkan might currently cause Valheim to be unstable and/or crash. If you want to continue using Vulkan, you can disable the FPS limiters in e.g. the Nvidia Control Panel for a hopefully smoother experience. Rest assured that we're working on a solution for the Vulkan issue, however, and that it should hopefully be back to normal soon!

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

* Added release-to-select in the radial menu: If you continue holding down the radial menu button/key after the radial menu appears, you can select an emote by releasing the button/key.
* Reverted crouching being unintentionally changed to a press-and-hold action on gamepad. Now it’s back to being a single press again.
* Fixed annoying resolution setting behavior in windowed mode when changing settings.
* Fixed crash on startup on Windows that triggers under specific conditions when using Vulkan.
* Fixed audio stutters in Ashlands.
* Fixed sometimes not being able to apply graphics settings properly the first time after updating from an earlier version.
* Fixed some minor UX issues in the graphics settings menu.

[b]For modders:[/b]
* Fixed a null reference exception that started happening in 0.221.10 when mods directly or indirectly accessed preferences at startup (for example via the localization system).

items.title: Patch 0.221.10 – Five Years of Valheim!
items.contents:
Greetings vikings!

Today marks the five year anniversary since Valheim was first released into Early Access – and what an incredible five years it’s been!

We want to thank everyone who has been a part of our journey and our community since then, whether you started playing on day one or have just been carried by the valkyrie for the first time. We greatly appreciate every single one of you, and we’re so glad to have you walk this path with us.

For this anniversary you will find a patch live right now for everyone, with some new celebratory items and emotes, along with some quality of life fixes!

If you want to keep the celebration going throughout the week, you can tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ard]Twitch[/url] on Thursday, where there will be a livestreamed concert by the Munich Radio Orchestra! They will be playing music from a bunch of video games, including Valheim.

As you all know, we’re working on Deep North, which will be the final biome update that brings the game into 1.0. While we can’t give an update on that today, we can share that 2026 is going to be a great year for Valheim. 

Once again, thank you so much for being with us for five whole years! 

Skål!!
/The Iron Gate team


[h2]Abbreviated Patch Notes:[/h2]

* A celebratory hat!
* Early Axes
* Frosted Sweetbread
* Added a radial menu for emotes
* New emotes
* New hairstyles
* 2 new buildable garlands
* Engine Upgrade
* Multiple bug fixes and improvements

[h2]Detailed Patch Notes:[/h2]

[spoiler][b]New Content:[/b]
* New Emote: Vibe
* New Emote: LoveYou
* New Buildpiece: Flower Garland
* New Buildpiece: Fey Lights
* New Consumable: Frosted Sweetbread
* New Weapon: Early Axes
* New Hat: Celebratory Cap
* 2 New Materials: Mysterious Axe Head, Curious Axe Head
* 3 New Hairstyles (Champion, Chronicler, Sunbringer)
* Added radial menu for emotes

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
* Tweaks to multiple hairstyles (Castellan, Painter Curls, Pulled Back Curls, Tidy Curls)
* Tweaks to berserker armour
* Carapace Buckler now provides 5 adrenaline instead of 10 on perfect block, just like other shields
* Updated Game Engine to Unity 6000.0.61f1
* Added localization string for tombstone container

[b]Reworked graphics settings:[/b]
* Replaced “Render scale” percentage slider with “3D resolution limit” dropdown with fixed resolutions – improves use case as performance target
* Added new “Upscaling method” setting with new “Pixelated” option
* Added new “Low” SSAO quality option, which achieves a similar look to the existing SSAO quality (now named “High”) with a significantly lower performance impact
* The frame rate limiter can now be used together with v-sync (chooses the lowest submultiple of the monitor refresh rate that is greater than or equal to the selected value)
* The frame rate limiter setting is now applied during the splash/loading screen
* The resolution dropdown setting now sorts resolutions from highest to lowest, instead of the other way around

[b]Optimizations:[/b]
* Change engine settings to improve performance in areas with many instances
* Massively reduced CPU usage of armor stands
* Skip texture copy for image effects (shield dome and heat distortion) when those effects aren’t being used, which should reduce GPU overhead in most areas
* Grass vegetation is no longer included in environment reflections, improving performance
* Ensure one-shot sound effects are started the same frame they’re created, reducing their latency by up to one frame
* Reduced memory usage of minimap
* Only load graphics presets for the current platform, rather than all platforms, reducing memory usage
* Removed a duplicated matchmaking manager that wasted performance in the start menu

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
* Fixed “Generating” progress bar not always being shown during world generation
* Fixed server list sometimes failing to save when quitting from the start menu
* Fixed crash that could occur in multiplayer when a T.W.I.G. throws a rock at a player who is at the edge of a shield dome
* Fixed crash that happened when hovering the cursor over a bee hive without being the network owner of that bee hive
* Fixed audio stutter that occurred when a lot of sounds were playing simultaneously
* Fixed Yggdrasil not being visible in environment reflections

[b]Mac App Store:[/b]
* Improved error message shown when trying to play online without being logged in to Game Center

[b]Steam: [/b]
* Player list now successfully shows profile pictures of non-friends too

[b]Xbox:[/b]
* All settings are now stored per-user and synchronized to the cloud, rather than being shared between all users on the console
* UI is now rendered at native resolution (up to 4K) on Xbox Series S|X and Xbox One X
* Improved graphics:
* Xbox One and Xbox One S: Added SSAO and increased number of point lights
* Xbox One X: Increased number of point lights
* Xbox Series S: Increased number of point lights and enabled point light shadows
* Xbox Series X: Increased number of point lights, enabled point light shadows and adjusted resolutions
* Reduce power draw even more when the game is running in the background

[b]Windows, Linux, MacOS:[/b]
* Reworked graphics presets and unified them across the three platforms
* Fixed automatic render scale sometimes being set incorrectly in windowed mode

[b]Steam Deck:[/b]
* Improved graphics presets:
* Performance mode now reaches 60 fps
* Optimized preset settings for battery life
* Native resolution is now used on first start, instead of 1366x768

[b]For modders:[/b]
* Sprite atlases are now included in the extended manifest file for Asset Bundles[/spoiler]

items.title: Eye On Ashenfall | 1.0.2
items.contents: [h3]This briefing is for your eyes only, agent. [/h3][p]We're back! Another month, another update. Let's talk about everything coming your way. A new quest, new activities, Earth Magic and... Penguins?[/p][h1]Earth Magic[/h1][p]Finally - the fourth element has arrived. Earth Magic joins Air, Fire and Water, and brings a new, earthy flavour to Magic.[/p][p]At level 14 Magic, you'll be able to equip Earth Runes for Staves and Wands. Earth attacks deal Blunt Damage, staggering enemies and interrupting attacks. [/p][p]Earth Magic specialises in AOE Damage, launching waves of earth at the target. The final hit of the Staff Combo hits the area around the target too, catching nearby enemies. The Staff's Special Attack creates an earthquake, with multiple aftershocks. Charge it to increase the affected area. Once cast, you can leave it to do its thing while you reposition, to make terrain difficult for your foes. [/p][p]There's also a defensive benefit to this - Armour of the Earth. Earth Magic hits build a defensive buff on you, reducing your damage taken. You can build up to 3 stacks, and they're consumed on your next incoming hit. You'll consume the stacks, and take less damage on that hit. Landing more hits keeps the stacks coming - so stay in the fight, push forward and maintain the stacks to reduce your damage. And, yes - At 60 Attack, you can enchant your melee weapons with this too, to build Armour of the Earth on-hit with melee as well.[/p][h1]Penguin Hunting[/h1][p]Ashenfall has been infiltrated by the Killer Gentoo Penguins - KGP for short - and we have received reports that over 200 of them have appeared across the continent of Ashenfall. It's time to get hunting. Penguins spawn in batches - no more than 3 agents at a time, per region. These reset at regular intervals of 7 in-game days so as you progress through your adventures, you'll spot more dotted around! Hidden in plain sight, these can be found, spotted and interacted with.[/p][p]Once they flee, you'll collect a token - evidence they were here - leaving you a Penguin Coin. This coin will be used at a new shop in Bramblemead, with a Full Penguin Armour Set, KGP Hat, a Penguin Cape, and decorations for your base including new tapestries from iconic RuneScape Art Community founding member, and legend of the Forums: [b]Prezleek.[/b][/p][p]We've also added an amulet that improves chances to catch Pristine Fish, and a ring that reduces stamina for reeling in fish to make it easier to reel in the big one! These are the first steps we're making to improve fishing based on your feedback! [/p][p]We'll be adding more rewards to the shop in the future so there'll be more to come back for, too![/p][h1]A Reel Downer - New Quest[/h1][p]Over in Umbral Sands, someone’s having a rather difficult fishing trip. Head to the Manafem Clan’s camp for our new quest, A Reel Downer. Their fisherman’s catch won’t stop crying, and the clan can’t stand the taste of miserable fish.You’ll need to help him find a way to cheer them up. Apparently, happy fish taste better.[/p][p]Finish the quest to unlock the Fishing Rod Rack recipe, giving your collection a proper display at home. You’ll also unlock trophy recipes for the sad fish, so if you catch a pristine one, you can mount it on your wall.[/p][p]Nothing brightens up a home quite like a miserable fish.[/p][h1]The Rug Pull[/h1][p]There’s a new trail to uncover in Umbral Sands.[/p][p]Four brothers stole a valuable carpet and some treasure from an ancient vault. But when the loot disappeared, greed and suspicion tore them apart.[/p][p]None of the brothers survived, but they left behind their final journal entries, each telling their side of the story....[/p][p]Find them scattered around the desert, piece together the clues and use the landmarks around you to work out where you need to dig.[/p][p]Follow the trail to unlock plans for two new rugs for your base! [/p][h1]Letter Deliveries[/h1][p]If you’ve completed Letters from the Dead in Fellhollow, Postie Pete has some new delivery routes for you, taking you into Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands.[/p][p]Buy the plans for a regional post box using that region’s currency, then build it at your base. Each post box gives you letters for its own region, so you can choose where to make your rounds.[/p][p]Deliveries in Dowdun Reach reward you with [b]Infernal Fragments[/b], which you can spend at Postie Pete’s [b]Evil Emporium[/b].[/p][p]Over in Umbral Sands, you’ll earn [b]Garou Chits[/b] to spend with the region’s merchants. Riches - or, a wage for your work, await! [/p][h1]PTR (Public Test Realm)[/h1][p]One suggestion we've heard a lot from players across our community spaces is something to the effect of "We'd love a PTR to help get hands on early and catch things if we can!"[/p][p]We think that's a great idea, and we're taking our first steps towards making this happen![/p][p]We'll start with a select group of PC players who will explore upcoming builds, put the new features through their paces and help us identify issues that we may otherwise miss. This also lets us learn what works and what doesn't to make the PTR experience even better, if we are going to build it into a regular part of developing Dragonwilds.[/p][p]What we want to be very transparent about a few things, though:[/p][p]Due to the long lead times required for Console submission, any PTR on Steam is the build that is being deployed to consoles on release date. That means some of the issues discovered in the PTR before release would be resolved in a later patch. [/p][p]Participation would also involve you backing up your saves and switching between a PTR branch and the Live version of the game. We'll provide instructions when the time comes, but it is crucial that you protect your progress when venturing across that Wilderness wall into the new branch![/p][p]We're going to test this out with a smaller, selected group initially to explore the branch, with dedicated spaces in Discord and Reddit to collate feedback - and contain spoilers. Our commitment in the wake of the PTR is that we will absolutely own, report and discuss what you discovered, what we're able to address, and what needs work. Diving into the PTR shouldn't just end with "Thanks for the feedback!" - we want it to feel like you know what happens next.[/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where door opening animations looked smooth for the host but not for clients on that world. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Spell Books/ Spell Wheels would show the incorrect spells for the page when opened after using a lodestone or opening an interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Ascending Masterwork Armour now correctly increases its stats. [/p][/*][*][p]When filling stacks in chests, the stacks will now no longer pull from the Quick Access Bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Streamlined the process of interacting with Processing Stations to reduce the number of inputs. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Player-built structures on Dedicated Servers would lose collision and you would clip through them in certain circumstances. [/p][/*][*][p]Getting 99 Agility will now correctly trigger the achievement on consoles. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix for users who lost the ability to use the item wheel after using spell wheel hotkeys a few times.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where summoning Sworn Servant "Buddy" would continually apply a Stamina Regen debuff even after despawning or expiring. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a new UI interface to showcase the number of enemies/waves attacking when a Base Raid event takes place. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clients in a hosted world would grow two trees from each planted seed. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix for the issue where the Quick Select wheel could not switch weapons during longer animations. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix for users who had adjusted their system clocks on PC being prevented from accessing Crossplay. [/p][/*][*][p]Deployed a fix where creating a new character using a renamed character's previous name would delete the original character.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for Crafting Recipes that require six different materials that caused the UI to overflow into the quantity section.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where users could use a broken 1-handed weapon by equipping a shield.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where opening/closing the map would cause your inventory to stay open. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Enchanted Weapon ambience has been tapped down.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Trunk Totem XP was multiplied incorrectly when various Trunk Totems were too close to each other. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix for High-Epic Graphics Settings displaying an incorrect LOD for a mountain in Umbral Sands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for an error message showing when disconnecting from the internet while logging in to Online play.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where adding an item to your inventory would cause the inventory items to sort. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an Audio issue where Hosts would hear other players' Magic Wand SFX as if they were right next to them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could drag unrelated items into the fuel/combustible slot in the Campfire. Stop that. [/p][/*][*][p]Fix for a crash due to an audio reverb issue. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where building menu icons looked pixelated. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI issue which caused the Compost Bins to display the incorrect status on use.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Gilded Gyrhawk, Glory, Strength, Magic and Salve Amulets were not calculating durability loss correctly with use. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]Armour of the Earth Hit Reacts are not triggering their bespoke SFX.[/p][/*][*][p]If a player receives the same location twice in a row for Postbox Letter Delivery, the player must leave the area and return to complete the delivery.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Dowdun Reach area, the Camera unexpectedly pulls into the player model in certain spots.[/p][/*][*][p]Clients may appear as a default character for a brief time when first loading into a large world. Give it a minute and you'll pop right in as your normal self.[/p][/*][*][p]After being opened and then closed, doors will be slightly offset.[/p][/*][*][p]Using a mount appearance consumable without either base mount unlocked, will incorrectly show 'Mounts Unlocked'.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing Up on the D-Pasd in the "Advanced" tab of Custom World Settings navigates up 5 menu entries, rather than the intended 1. Down on the D-Pad works fine! [/p][/*][/list][p]These two in particular have been on our radar and we're introducing more telemetry tracking with 1.0.2 to help us better log data on these to investigate further:[/p][list][*][p]Stuttering during auto-save following 1.0.1 update[/p][/*][*][p]In some instances, only one client will be able to join an Xbox-hosted world. [/p][/*][/list][p]And that’s JUST this month’s update! Next month, we’ll have…[/p][h1]Luminance[/h1][p]This December, Elves arrive in Ashenfall with the Luminance Update, bringing a new adventure, the musical magic of the Lyre and a new way to build and shape your journey across Ashenfall.[/p][p]You'll be exploring a new outpost area that will emerge from the fog on the edges of Ashenfall, meet new characters and learn to pluck, strum or otherwise noodle on a Lyre to resonate with songstones to progress! A continent wide hunt for a sinister Bounty Hunter will net you valuable resources and a way to earn Harmonised Crystal Fragments - valuable currency if you're in the market for new Elven gear. (You are, by the way.)[/p][p]Embrace the Elven fantasy with a new Prifddinas-inspired building kit, a range of new character customisation options and craftable Elven armour and Weapons![/p][p]And what's a RuneScape adventure without another skill to level? Prayer joins Dragonwilds this December! Call upon Saradomin to smite your foes, Guthix to keep you and your friends in the fight, or Zamorak to trade a little health for some serious extra damage. Just remember, the gods all have their own ideas about how you should survive Ashenfall.[/p][p]All of this lays the foundations and weaves in the first threads of our most ambitious, exciting questline yet in the Blood Crystal Saga. There's still dragons involved, of course. [/p][p]Alongside all of this, we're continuing to improve the core experience with quality-of-life changes across platforms and targeted visual improvements for Nintendo Switch 2.[/p][p]For now, that’s all we’ve got - but we’ll be in touch again soon. Until next time, have fun out there, adventurers. Be good, and we’ll see you in Ashenfall![/p]

it.title: Occhi su Ashenfall | 1.0.2
it.text:
# Questo briefing è riservato solo a te, agente.
Siamo tornati! Un altro mese, un altro aggiornamento. Parliamo di tutto ciò che sta per arrivare. Una nuova quest, nuove attività, Earth Magic e... Pinguini?
# Earth Magic
Finalmente: il quarto elemento è arrivato. Earth Magic si unisce ad Air, Fire e Water, portando un nuovo tocco terreno a Magic.
Al livello 14 di Magic, potrai equipaggiare le Earth Runes per Staves e Wands. Gli attacchi di terra infliggono Blunt Damage, sbilanciando i nemici e interrompendo i loro attacchi.
Earth Magic si specializza in AOE Damage, lanciando ondate di terra contro il bersaglio. L'ultimo colpo della Staff Combo colpisce anche l'area intorno al bersaglio, travolgendo i nemici vicini. Lo Special Attack della Staff crea un terremoto con scosse di assestamento multiple. Caricalo per aumentare l'area d'effetto. Una volta lanciato, puoi lasciarlo agire mentre ti riposizioni, così da rendere il terreno difficile per i tuoi nemici.
C'è anche un beneficio difensivo: Armour of the Earth. I colpi di Earth Magic accumulano un buff difensivo su di te, riducendo i danni subiti. Puoi accumulare fino a 3 stack, che verranno consumati al prossimo colpo che riceverai. Consumerai gli stack e subirai meno danni da quel colpo. Mettendo a segno altri colpi continuerai ad accumulare stack, quindi resta in combattimento, avanza e mantieni gli stack per ridurre i danni. E sì: a 60 di Attack, potrai incantare anche le tue armi da mischia con questo effetto, per accumulare Armour of the Earth colpendo in mischia.
# Penguin Hunting
Ashenfall è stata infiltrata dai Killer Gentoo Penguins (KGP in breve) e abbiamo ricevuto segnalazioni che più di 200 di loro sono apparsi in tutto il continente di Ashenfall. È ora di andare a caccia. I pinguini compaiono a gruppi: non più di 3 agenti alla volta per regione. Si resettano a intervalli regolari di 7 giorni di gioco, quindi man mano che procedi nelle tue avventure ne noterai altri in giro! Nascosti alla vista di tutti, possono essere trovati, individuati e con cui interagire.
Una volta fuggiti, raccoglierai un gettone (la prova che erano lì) che ti lascerà una Penguin Coin. Questa moneta potrà essere usata in un nuovo negozio a Bramblemead, che offre un Full Penguin Armour Set, KGP Hat, una Penguin Cape e decorazioni per la tua base, inclusi nuovi arazzi dell'iconico membro fondatore della RuneScape Art Community e leggenda dei Forum: Prezleek.
Abbiamo anche aggiunto un amuleto che migliora le probabilità di catturare Pristine Fish e un anello che riduce la stamina necessaria per tirare a riva i pesci, rendendo più facile catturare le prede più grandi! Questi sono i primi passi che stiamo compiendo per migliorare la pesca in base ai vostri feedback!
In futuro aggiungeremo altre ricompense al negozio, quindi ci sarà sempre un motivo per tornare!
# A Reel Downer - New Quest
Nelle Umbral Sands, qualcuno sta avendo una battuta di pesca piuttosto difficile. Dirigiti al campo del Manafem Clan per la nostra nuova quest, A Reel Downer. Il pescato del loro pescatore non smette di piangere e il clan non sopporta il sapore dei pesci tristi. Dovrai aiutarlo a trovare un modo per tirarli su di morale. A quanto pare, i pesci felici hanno un sapore migliore.
Completa la quest per sbloccare la ricetta del Fishing Rod Rack, dando alla tua collezione un'adeguata esposizione a casa. Sbloccherai anche le ricette per i trofei dei pesci tristi, così se ne catturi uno pristine, potrai appenderlo al muro.
Niente illumina una casa come un pesce triste.
# The Rug Pull
C'è una nuova pista da scoprire nelle Umbral Sands.
Quattro fratelli hanno rubato un tappeto prezioso e un tesoro da una cripta antica. Ma quando la refurtiva è scomparsa, l'avidità e il sospetto li hanno divisi.
Nessuno dei fratelli è sopravvissuto, ma si sono lasciati alle spalle le ultime pagine dei loro diari, e ognuno racconta la propria versione della storia....
Trovale sparse per il deserto, metti insieme gli indizi e usa i punti di riferimento intorno a te per capire dove devi scavare.
Segui la pista per sbloccare i progetti di due nuovi tappeti per la tua base!
# Letter Deliveries
Se hai completato Letters from the Dead a Fellhollow, Postie Pete ha nuove rotte di consegna per te, che ti porteranno in Dowdun Reach e Umbral Sands.
Acquista i progetti per una cassetta delle lettere regionale usando la valuta di quella regione, poi costruiscila nella tua base. Ogni cassetta delle lettere ti dà lettere per la propria regione, così puoi scegliere dove fare i tuoi giri di consegna.
Le consegne in Dowdun Reach ti ricompensano con Infernal Fragments, che puoi spendere presso il Postie Pete’s Evil Emporium.
Nelle Umbral Sands, guadagnerai Garou Chits da spendere con i mercanti della regione. Ti aspettano ricchezze... o una paga per il tuo lavoro!
# PTR (Public Test Realm)
Un suggerimento che abbiamo sentito spesso dai giocatori in tutta la nostra community è qualcosa del tipo: "Ci piacerebbe avere un PTR per provarlo prima e scovare eventuali problemi!"
Pensiamo che sia un'ottima idea e stiamo muovendo i primi passi per realizzarla!
Inizieremo con un gruppo selezionato di giocatori PC che esploreranno le prossime build, metteranno alla prova le nuove funzionalità e ci aiuteranno a identificare i problemi che altrimenti ci sfuggirebbero. Questo ci permette anche di capire cosa funziona e cosa no per rendere l'esperienza PTR ancora migliore, nel caso dovesse diventare una parte regolare dello sviluppo di Dragonwilds.
Vogliamo però essere molto trasparenti su alcuni punti:
A causa dei lunghi tempi di attesa richiesti per l'approvazione su console, qualsiasi PTR su Steam sarà la build distribuita sulle console alla data di uscita. Ciò significa che alcuni dei problemi scoperti nel PTR prima del lancio verranno risolti in una patch successiva.
La partecipazione richiederà inoltre di fare il backup dei tuoi salvataggi e di passare da un ramo PTR alla versione Live del gioco. Forniremo istruzioni quando sarà il momento, ma è fondamentale proteggere i tuoi progressi quando oltrepassi quel Wilderness wall per entrare nel nuovo ramo!
Inizialmente lo testeremo con un gruppo ristretto e selezionato per esplorare il ramo, con spazi dedicati su Discord e Reddit per raccogliere i feedback e contenere gli spoiler. Il nostro impegno in merito al PTR è quello di assumere la piena responsabilità, segnalare e discutere quanto scoperto, ciò che possiamo risolvere e ciò che richiede altro lavoro. Immergersi nel PTR non deve concludersi solo con un "Grazie per il feedback!": vogliamo che tu sappia cosa succederà dopo.
# Bug Fixes
•
Risolto un problema per cui le animazioni di apertura delle porte risultavano fluide per l'host ma non per i client in quel mondo.
[/*]

L'Masterwork Armour ascendente ora aumenta correttamente le sue statistiche.

Raggiungere 99 in Agility ora sbloccherà correttamente l'achievement su console.
[/*]

[/*]
•
Risolto un problema per cui l'evocazione dello Sworn Servant "Buddy" applicava continuamente un debuff alla Stamina Regen anche dopo il despawn o la scadenza.
[/*]
•
Aggiunta una nuova interfaccia UI per mostrare il numero di nemici/ondate in attacco quando si verifica un evento Base Raid.
[/*]
•
Risolto un problema per cui i client in un mondo ospitato facevano crescere due alberi da ciascun seme piantato.

Implementata una correzione per cui la creazione di un nuovo personaggio utilizzando il nome precedente di un personaggio rinominato eliminava il personaggio originale.
[/*]
•

[/*]

[/*]

Risolto un problema per cui le icone del menu di costruzione apparivano sgranate.
[/*]

[/*]
