# Known Issues
•
Gli Hit Reacts di Armour of the Earth non attivano i propri SFX dedicati.
[/*]
•
Se un giocatore riceve la stessa posizione due volte di seguito per la Postbox Letter Delivery, il giocatore deve lasciare l'area e ritornarvi per completare la consegna.
[/*]
•
Nell'area di Dowdun Reach, la telecamera si avvicina inaspettatamente al modello del giocatore in certi punti.
[/*]
•
I client potrebbero apparire come personaggio predefinito per un breve periodo durante il primo caricamento in un mondo di grandi dimensioni. Dagli un minuto e tornerai al tuo aspetto normale.
[/*]
•
Dopo essere state aperte e poi chiuse, le porte risulteranno leggermente disallineate.
[/*]
•
L'uso di un consumabile per l'aspetto della cavalcatura senza aver sbloccato alcuna cavalcatura base mostrerà erroneamente 'Mounts Unlocked'.
[/*]
•
Premendo Su sul D-Pad nella scheda "Advanced" delle impostazioni del Custom World, ci si sposta in alto di 5 voci di menu anziché di 1 come previsto. Giù sul D-Pad funziona correttamente!
[/*]
Questi due in particolare sono stati sotto la nostra attenzione e stiamo introducendo un tracciamento telemetrico maggiore con la 1.0.2 per aiutarci a registrare meglio i dati su di essi e indagare ulteriormente:
•
Scatti durante il salvataggio automatico in seguito all'aggiornamento 1.0.1
[/*]
•
In alcuni casi, solo un client sarà in grado di entrare in un mondo ospitato su Xbox.
[/*]
E questo è SOLO l'aggiornamento di questo mese! Il prossimo mese avremo…
# Luminance
Questo dicembre, gli elfi arrivano in Ashenfall con l'aggiornamento Luminance, portando una nuova avventura, la magia musicale della Lyre e un nuovo modo di costruire e plasmare il tuo viaggio in Ashenfall.
Esplorerai una nuova area avamposto che emergerà dalla nebbia ai confini di Ashenfall, incontrerai nuovi personaggi e imparerai a pizzicare, strimpellare o giocherellare con una Lyre per risuonare con le songstones e procedere! Una caccia su tutto il continente a un sinistro Bounty Hunter ti frutterà preziose risorse e un modo per guadagnare Harmonised Crystal Fragments, una valuta preziosa se sei in cerca di nuovo equipaggiamento elfico. (E lo sei, a proposito.)
Abbraccia il fantasy elfico con un nuovo kit di costruzione ispirato a Prifddinas, una serie di nuove opzioni di personalizzazione del personaggio ed Elven armour e Weapons realizzabili!
E cos'è un'avventura di RuneScape senza un'altra skill da livellare? Prayer arriva su Dragonwilds questo dicembre! Invoca Saradomin per punire i tuoi nemici, Guthix per mantenere te e i tuoi amici in combattimento, o Zamorak per scambiare un po' di salute per ingenti danni extra. Ricorda solo che gli dei hanno tutti le proprie idee su come dovresti sopravvivere ad Ashenfall.
Tutto questo getta le basi e intreccia i primi fili della nostra serie di quest più ambiziosa ed entusiasmante di sempre nella Blood Crystal Saga. Ci sono ancora i draghi di mezzo, ovviamente.
Oltre a tutto ciò, continuiamo a migliorare l'esperienza principale con modifiche alla quality-of-life su tutte le piattaforme e miglioramenti visivi mirati per Nintendo Switch 2.
Per ora è tutto ciò che abbiamo, ma ci risentiremo presto. Fino alla prossima volta, buon divertimento là fuori, avventurieri. Fate i bravi e ci vediamo in Ashenfall!

items.title: Our 1.0.1 update is now live! | Eye on Ashenfall
items.contents: [h1]Save Fixes[/h1][p]The big headline for this one is a range of fixes targeting the disappearing world saves we've seen reported, as well as a catch-up mechanic for corrupted character saves that will let you drop in with aggregated stats and Tier 4 gear to get you back in the fight. Hop in and give those a try, but we're aware there may still be the occasional player affected by other, extraneous instances of save issues that we're still collecting data on. We're talking about very, very small numbers of affected players, but it matters all the same. Beyond that, let's get into what else is coming in 1.0.1.[/p][h1]1.0.1 and Core Improvements[/h1][h2]What goes up...[/h2][list][*][p]Introducing... the Jump Attack. It does exactly what you think it does.[/p][list][*][p]Unlock the Skill Tree perk "Death From Above!"[/p][list][*][p]Any time you are [i]slightly [/i]above the max height of the double jump's arc from the ground, inputting an attack will plunge you downward to slam into unfortunate victims below. Damage scales with the weapon you have equipped, so make sure you're holding something hefty before you leap. And yes, Windstep counts here. What goes up, must come crashing down. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]I've Got Shooters[/h2][list][*][p]Added the Ranged skill perk - Ammo Recovery, and it's Greater version later in the Skill Tree - Greater Ammo Recovery. [/p][list][*][p]Adds a chance to recover arrows from the bodies of slain enemies. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ranged weapon subclasses are receiving their own special attack variants to make them feel more aligned with the fantasy of using the Shortbow, Longbow or Crossbow. [/p][list][*][p]Shortbow: Rapid Fire - Hop backwards and fire off three arrows in quick succession. The target can be switched between this volley of shots to spread the damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Longbow: Power Shot - take a knee to draw an arrow at full strength. Let fly to loose a staggering, enormously powerful shot at great distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Crossbow: Heavy Bolt - rack a bolt and let it fly after a short charge. Hits like Asgarnian Ale on an empty stomach, and applies Enchanted effects on-hit.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Introduced the Low Blow Skill Perk: Ranged attacks that hit the enemy in the legs (lower third of the body or their legs) applies "Hamstrung" which reduces enemy movement speed for a short while. Tiny and Colossal Enemies are immune. [/p][/*][/list][h2]...And The Rest[/h2][list][*][p]Increased inventory space from 32 to 40. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a toggle for the Visceral Attack Camera change.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564297/dcc0ae363f139cbef8c1b6618c63f587d028bf79.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where users on mounts could not open the map correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Obstacles and Enemies now respawn in the Scorned Wildnerness Raid on reset/next run-through.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced aggro range for enemies across the game to prevent forming a bit of a follow-train like a Fally Drop Party. [/p][/*][*][p]Enemy mob respawn timers extended so they stay dead for longer as you clear areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where users on controller were unable to sort chests with L3/LS correctly. [/p][/*][*][p]Polish pass on Mining nodes across the world to ensure they're all above ground and can be mined.[/p][/*][*][p]Goblin "barks" (ambient noises they make) should now sound less like they've just seen you and are yelling.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements on the Sort functionality - Weight, Type and Latest. [/p][list][*][p]Weight: Cumulative Stack Weight, Heaviest First.[/p][/*][*][p]Type: Categories of item, alphabetically. [/p][/*][*][p]Latest: The most recently picked up items first. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adding a dedicated Ring AND Amulet slot.[/p][list][*][p]Thanks to Thurnax, NeganTWD, Cloud_N0ne and others who suggested this. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Amulet of Glory was providing additional bonuses above what was initially intended, so we're tapping those numbers back down to better align with what we wanted it to be.[/p][/*][*][p]We're adding the Ultra Compost Bin - because "Super" just wasn't cutting it anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Adding the Large Compost Bucket, which has a larger capacity.[/p][list][*][p]Now stop asking. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adding a Completed Quests tab including a short summary of the outcome of the quest. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564297/22ea138ad3d82090764d5ed65ea9c05e3ee97cde.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Overdrive can now be cast on the Advanced Spinning Wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]Rune Arrows and Bolts now do more damage than Adamant. 4.9x versus 4.2x.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fishing Cape now correctly displays the Skillcape Perk - You have a small chance to instantly catch a fish.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the ability to rebind keybinds for settings that could soft lock the player in certain instances:[/p][list][*][p]Interaction[/p][list][*][p]Remove Spell[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Building[/p][list][*][p]Cancel Building[/p][/*][*][p]Quick Interact[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Crafting[/p][list][*][p]Crafting Tab Left/Right[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Quest Dialogue[/p][list][*][p]Continue Conversation[/p][/*][*][p]Cancel Conversation[/p][/*][*][p]Select Answer 1/2/3/4[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Additional Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where users could clip through the floor when teleporting to Cataclysm Keep from Commander Zilyana.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where PS5 users were unable to see the assigned Sort button on chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Players who had acquired Quest Items early (through multiplayer sessions) would be unable to progress to the next region. E.g. Imaru's Head prevented the player from entering Fellhollow, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where users could crash when selecting Online play while being Offline.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rain would cause visual effects to be visible inside player housing at any graphical setting. It no longer rains indoors![/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Sanguine Urns within the radius of the Scorned Wilderness were not displaying correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Skills Page description states Magic Focus can be crafted at the Crafting Table instead of the Blacksmith's Bench.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where images in the Journal could scale incorrectly. Begone, giant Bandos symbol![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hosts would unlock achivements triggered by a player in the world. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug causing Ascension Cores to not drop from Kuldra in some circumstances. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where users with Emojis in their name on PC would not be able to join PS5 or XBOX player hosted worlds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Dragon Med Helm icon to be the right shade of red. So, so sorry.[/p][/*][*][p]All platforms can now access the UI Scaling option as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Special Attacks from Ranged will now trigger gamepad vibration as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Maple Sap would not be removed from the inventory on death. incomplete Waterfall VFX in the Fractured Plains.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Inventory being open would not show tooltips on XBOX or PC.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent Cursor items.summary:
• Nuovi attacchi speciali Ranged, l'abilità Jump Attack, slot dedicati per Ring e Amulet ed estensione dell'inventario a 40 slot.
• Aggiunti la scheda Completed Quests, l'Ultra Compost Bin, ordinamenti migliorati e il recupero dei salvataggi corrotti con Tier 4 gear.
• Aumentato il danno di Rune Arrows e Bolts, depotenziato l’Amulet of Glory e ridotto il raggio di aggro dei nemici.
• Risolti bug a salvataggi persi, avanzamento quest, interfaccia, comandi via controller, audio e prestazioni generali tra le varie piattaforme.

items.title: Our 1.0.0.8 patch is live!
items.contents:
[p]Hello adventurers!

The 1.0.0.8 update is now live on XBOX, PS5, EGS, Steam, Jagex Launcher and Nintendo Switch 2.[/p][p]
Dedicated Servers will need to be restarted to apply the hotfix.[/p][list][*][p]1.0.0.8[/p][list][*][p]Fix for an issue which would cause World Saves to disappear under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Worlds that have previously disappeared will still not be visible - until 1.0.1.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]1.0.1 - Launching Next Week:[/p][list][*][p]A range of content updates and fixes, as well as:[/p][/*][*][p]World saves that have disappeared should hopefully be restored.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters that have been corrupted are once again able to join worlds, and have been given items and skill levels in compensation for the loss of progress.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
If you're using a dedicated server, we've been made aware of an ongoing issue where SteamCMD updates pulling the patch into Dedicated Servers are being rate limited. We're working with our partners at Shockbyte to continue to investigate a more permanent fix for this.[/p]
items.author: Mod Doom
items.summary:
• La patch 1.0.1 della prossima settimana introdurrà nuovi contenuti, correzioni e ripristinerà i World Saves scomparsi.
• I personaggi corrotti riavranno l'accesso ai mondi e riceveranno oggetti e livelli abilità come compensazione nella 1.0.1.
• Rilevati problemi di rate limit con SteamCMD per i Dedicated Servers, in fase di risoluzione con Shockbyte.
• La patch 1.0.0.8 risolve un bug che causava la scomparsa dei World Saves in determinate condizioni.

items.title: 1.0.0.6 is now Live!
items.contents: [list][*][p]Epic Games Store players are now back online and can enjoy Crossplay again![/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where users could quit the Edit Appearance menu before the Character Save had completed.[/p][list][*][p]This is a preventative measure - work towards currently affected "corrupted" saves is still ongoing. [u][b]We'll share an update later today.[/b][/u][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue on PC where incorrect filenames would be accepted as Character files.[/p][/*][*][p]Some corrupted World Saves were no longer visible in the menu for players.[/p][list][*][p]For some users, this save may also let you rejoin the world - but we are not considering this a comprehensive fix. Some users may still not be able to access their world after this fix, but the visibility of the world in the list was the core target of this step in our process.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some  users would crash when selecting "Online" play while being offline.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

items.title: 1.0.0.5 Patch Notes - Releasing Friday
items.contents: [p]Hello adventurers![/p][h1]We’re targeting this hotfix to go live on Friday.[/h1][p]We’re sharing the notes with you [b]today[/b] so you’re aware of where we’re at, and we’ll be submitting it the consoles with the expectation that this verification [b]will take several days[/b].[/p][p]This is based on your feedback around the updates knocking crossplay offline – we hear you, and we’re trying to avoid a weekend of disrupted gameplay for Nintendo Switch 2 players.[/p][p]The big topic of conversation is: we’re investigating the fixes about Save Corruption – world and character. We’re testing methods that will, [b]hopefully[/b], restore your missing saves. We need longer to investigate these solutions and the potential recovery options.[/p][p]We’re removing the [b]most common cause[/b], to mitigate impact for further people: [b]the Edit Appearance button is going to disappear until we’ve resolved the issue.[/b][/p][p]Restoring some saves has meant that the world has been reset to default settings – which means that Custom or Creative worlds will have been reverted to Normal worlds. These might be in your Normal save lists![/p][h1]Here’s what we’re targeting a fix with 1.0.0.5 on Friday:[/h1][list][*][p]Users no longer fail to connect to Multiplayer servers with more than 2 players present[/p][list][*][p]This also specifically resolves multiplayer clients on XBOX being unable to connect if 2 users are already in the world.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]AI will now respawn as intended on starting the second Scorned Wilderness Raid attempt.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing an issue where joining a modded Dedicated Server from consoles would corrupt a player save.[/p][/*][*][p]Primordial Hearts, Imbued Granite Maul Heads and Chinchompa Skulls can now all be destroyed or stored.[/p][/*][*][p]Dying in the Scorned Wilderness Raid will no longer skip a respawn point.[/p][/*][*][p]The Abyssal Whip Recipe now unlocks for users with existing character saves as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Sworn Servant could not be cast in Multiplayer/Dedicated Servers.[/p][/*][*][p]Hud Scale options are now correctly labelled on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Players with Privacy and Safety Settings on XBOX will be notified when a conflicting privacy setting prevents them from going online.[/p][/*][*][p]On controller, Processing Stations will now highlight the button where the players cursor is located.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolving an issue where Dedicated Server owners could not edit their dedicated server worlds on consoles.[/p][/*][*][p]The Server search bar has an added tooltip to specify that it is Case Sensitive.[/p][/*][*][p]The Switch 2 Video Capture is now working as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolving a bug where PS5 users could trigger a crash when creating a crossplay world with a password in certain instances.[/p][/*][*][p]“Self-hosted Server” button in Steam will now navigate the player to the hosting Tools.[/p][/*][*][p]Luminite ore can now be crafted into Divine Rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]DLSS and FSR upscaling are now available in the Video Settings for Windows/XBOX Game Pass versions.[/p][/*][*][p]Summon Shelter will be able to be used in the Scorned Wilderness hub.[/p][/*][/list][h1]On our radar:[/h1][p]We’re aware of an issue where if you disconnect from your internet/wifi and try and select Play Online, the game will instead crash. Targeting a fix in 1.0.1 for this![/p][p]We’ve got a few keybinds that can be currently re-bound that aren’t intended to be remapped. We’ll be resetting these to default binds with the 1.0.1 update too![/p][p]Thank you for your continued patience, support and feedback. We’re very excited to keep polishing, refining and growing RuneScape: Dragonwilds for years to come. Next weekend, at RuneFest, we’ll be showing our roadmap in more detail and we’re looking forward to sharing more about 1.0.1, October’s update, very soon too.[/p]
items.author: Mod Doom

items.title: Eye on Ashenfall | 1.0.0.4 Patch
items.contents:
[p]Hello adventurers! Firstly, we want to thank you for your enthusiasm, passion and support for our 1.0 release. It's been truly humbling and exhilarating seeing you all take on Kuldra, and we're already hard at work reviewing the data, assessing feedback and making plans. For now, though, we're pleased to be deploying a hotfix to tackle several issues.[/p][list][*][p]We have applied a fix affecting World Saves becoming corrupted when exiting a game session![/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where casting a Fishing Rod at a player-made structure crashed the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where adjusting some parts of the settings will cause a crash.[/p][/*][/list][p]We're still investigating an additional issue reported where some users have found that worlds in their world list have gone missing/turned invisible. We're in active conversation with the platform teams from each console to better understand the situation, with the aim of helping players recover these worlds and have them reappear in a future patch. This will require additional testing to verify.

The process for deploying this patch does, however, mean that [b]Nintendo Switch 2 and Jagex Launcher[/b] systems will [b]no longer be able to crossplay until the patch has been processed on their respective platforms[/b]. We'll update in the comments when these have been processed and the platforms allow you to dive back into Crossplay![/p]

items.title: The Wrath of the Dragon Event is live TOMORROW!
items.contents:
[p]RuneScape: Dragonwilds is celebrating its launch with our biggest ever Creator-driven event: Wrath of the Dragons! [/p][p]Tomorrow, on Saturday 19th September, at 9AM PDT/12PM EDT/5PM BST/6PM CET, 32 creators will step into Dragonwilds’ 1.0 release, and will be given just [b]6 hours[/b] to prepare a fresh character to beat the first Dragon in Dragonwilds - Velgar.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564297/eea7539ab0ab624e1d6d88cfcfc90b5b4629ed23.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you first slayed a big green dragon in 2001, or 2026, you know RuneScape, so you know this story. Heroes are called to become a Dragon Slayer. This time, four heroes are called, together, to slay a Dragon - but Kuldra won’t let that happen without a few twists. [/p][p]The wild anima of Ashenfall means that every hour, the world will shift with a few custom modifiers to make our creators more powerful - or more vulnerable! They might find that their attacks suddenly hurt each other, or that their hunger might be fatal if left unchecked. Their magic may suddenly have no cooldowns, or their crafting stations may suddenly surge with power and process much faster! Whatever powers they’re going to be getting, expect there to be plenty of chaotic moments and a few surprises thrown in for good measure. [/p][p]If you’re watching live, you can earn yourself the RuneScape: Dragonwilds Twitch Badge for watching 30 minutes of any stream in the Twitch Category - and you’ll be spoiled for choice. We’ve got 32 amazing guests taking part in the event, from across RuneScape, Old School RuneScape, and the wide world beyond.  [/p][p]Tune in to your favourite team, or see the WHOLE event live from the RuneScape: Dragonwilds Twitch Channel, where we’ll be giving away copies of the game and consoles too! Head over to [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/rsdragonwilds"][/dynamiclink] to catch the event live tomorrow! [/p][p]

[/p]
items.author: Mod Doom

items.title: Eye on Ashenfall | Our 1.0 Release is live!
items.contents: [p]Today marks the start of our next journey. Thank you to the millions (yes, millions!) of you who joined us during Early Access. We're now live on [url="https://store.playstation.com/product/EP5300-PPSA34114_00-0779566544583078"]PlayStation 5[/url], Nintendo Switch 2, [url="https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9NZCGJJB5R61"]XBOX Series X | S[/url] and PC on [url="https://store.epicgames.com/p/runescape-dragonwilds-runescape-dragonwilds-deluxe-edition-6d127e"]Epic Games Store[/url], [url="https://dragonwilds.runescape.com/"]Jagex Launcher[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374490/RuneScape_Dragonwilds/"]Steam[/url].[/p][h1]Our Early Access Journey[/h1][p]In April 2025 we launched into Early Access with the first Dragon General, Velgar, and the first two regions: Brynmoor and Ghornfell. We launched with 9 unique skills to level up, unlocking powerful, transformative Skill Spells to make the mundanity of survival a little more magical – no more grinding through countless trees, chopping until the sun comes up. 12 Unique armour sets, across 3 combat styles, supported by a range of weapons up to Iron tier.[/p][p]In June 2025 we expanded our Magic Skill Tree, added additional building pieces including the Palisade Walls for protecting against Base Raids (which we’ve rebalanced and tuned down based on player feedback).[/p][p]In September we added Ranged skill tree abilities including Hunter Sense, Spectral Arrow and and Snare Skill Spells. We also added poison, barbed and flaming arrows to deal poison, bleed and fire damage, as well as enchanted bolts for Crossbows (including the iconic Blurite Crossbow). We also added the Custom and Creative world options with over 50 custom world setting variables for you to make your world, your way, and tens of thousands of creative and custom worlds have been made since then! [/p][p]In December, our first Major Update “Fellhollow” arrived with the Farming skill, a new building kit, two new NPCs and a shop for trading Soul Fragments with Death himself. Material upgrades brought you the Castle kit to make a spooky stronghold. You can also earn and equip Steel tier gear, complete with its iconic plumed Full Helm, and then made RuneScape history by adding Mounts! Ride a terrorbird and traverse the treacherous terrain in style! The second Dragon boss, Imaru the Revenant Dragon has tested, and will continue to test, the strength of your soul and offers unique rewards for those who grant her finality and peace.[/p][p][img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/WICbTehr0q1lflHrMx61etRt1wY.png" style="aspect-ratio: 1920 / 1080;"][/img][/p][p]We added more to Fellhollow with our minor updates, monthly content drops adding quests, rewards and new decorations – new repeatable content in the form of Spectral Platforming, Buried Treasures and Letters for the Dead, and quests in the form of “Things That Go Boom In The Night”, “Doric’s Quest”, “Letters for the Dead”, “What Remains is Written” and “Mirror, Mirror”.[/p][p]In March, we launched our next Major Update, with 4 more quests for players to take on, a new boss to overcome in the legendary Black Knight Titan, and a new region – Dowdun Reach. We launched support for Dedicated Servers, improved controller support, and a ton of bug fixes, before the arrival of Fishing. [/p][p][img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/H8ZOS9RD779fd3yFCfLETgcGw9w.png" style="aspect-ratio: 1920 / 1080;"][/img][/p][p]We added three new quests: “Cook’s Assistant”, “Animal Magnetism” and “A Room with a Garou” alongside the Fishing skill which let you catch pristine fish to make new wall-mounted decorative trophies of your finest catches, providing the best healing-per-stack of any food item. We added Auto-run, auto-magnetising nearby items in the world to reduce inputs picking up items around you, the option to hide your helmet to show off your beautiful face and stopped Chickens, Cows and Kebbits from automatically attacking the player unprovoked so you can enjoy your cozy abode or a chill walk around in peace.[/p][p][img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/OccuPZdkqacJER4niXWnWhq39E.png" style="aspect-ratio: 1920 / 1080;"][/img][/p][p]We reworked health and healing to let you tick-eat food like the other RuneScape games for optimal survivability in combat. We removed Wardstone to make your health bar more clearly representing your survivability, but also adding Sanguine Urns around the world to increase your Max HP by 10, permanently, for each unique one you find and use.[/p][p]Our latest and largest Major Update, Umbral Sands, introduced a new form of Mount – the flying carpet – and introduced you to a region inspired by the Kharidian Deserts of RuneScape. Within this region, we introduced the Kalphite Queen and her brood, Fuzan the Fire Dragon and the Kot’Haar, sentient golems of Obsidian, given life by an Elder Artefact. We also added the Nightmare Crucible, allowing you to earn upgrade materials to power up your favourite weapons from lower Power Levels to be max level to face Kuldra with the release of Scorned Wilderness.  The region allows users to craft Adamant Armour, Red Dragonhide and Infinity Robes as well as additional vestiges including Obsidian Armour, the Obsidian shield and the Fire Cape. We expanded the Skill Trees for Mining and Woodcutting, giving you new Skill Spells and passive rewards, and added more NPC traders for users to trade with. [/p][p][img src="https://framerusercontent.com/images/SKDl2hlRvRZIC3eGFpDbGUpG4.jpg" style="aspect-ratio: 3840 / 2160;"][/img][/p][h1]What's New in 1.0?[/h1][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p]Added support for Consoles! This includes PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, XBOX Series X | S and PC on Epic Games Store, Jagex Launcher and Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Crossplay! [/p][list][*][p]In the in-game menu, worlds can now be enabled as crossplay when you load them.[/p][/*][*][p]Crossplay worlds will be shown in the world browser.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now have the option to make their worlds crossplay or not each time they host a multiplayer world[/p][/*][*][p]Dedicated servers now also have crossplay option.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now join worlds through invite codes! Invite codes can be entered in the world browser screen, and are shown in the in game pause menu.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added the Scorned Wilderness quest: [b]Regicide.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added the Scorned Wilderness region. This area includes "The Hub" which is a new area which players can build in, and the Raid area which does not permit building, because of the big dragon. Speaking of which...[/p][/*][*][p]Added new end-game boss, Kuldra, the God-Eater![/p][list][*][p]Big Momma herself. [b][i]Don't actually call her that. [/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Goblin Thug[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Goblin Poisonshot Archer[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Garou Exile[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Garou Lightning Berserker[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Rotsworn Reanimator[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Skeletal Blightshot[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Black Knight Crusader[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Blazing Black Knight[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Stormpact Demon [/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy type: Black Dragons[/p][/*][/list][p]We've got plenty of new gear for you to get stuck into, too. [/p][list][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Helmet[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Platebody[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Platelegs[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Shield[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Dagger[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Mace[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Greataxe[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Greatsword[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Sword[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Scimitar[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Warhammer[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Crossbow[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Black Dragonhide Coif[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Black Dragonhide Body[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Black Dragonhide Chaps[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Magic Longbow[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Magic Shortbow[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Rune Crossbow[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Ancestral Hat[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Ancestral Robes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Ancestral Robe Legs[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Ancestral Wand[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Ancestral Staff[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Kuldra's Wrath[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Dragon Full Helm[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Dragon Platebody[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Dragon Platelegs[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Dragon Med Helm[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Dragon Shield[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new item: Dragon Scimitar[/p][list][*][p]The Dragon Scimmy is real, chat![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Killing Kuldra will ensure you get a drop - the Dragon Kiteshield, and then a Cape to wear with pride. In a slight deviation from previous iterations, this shield won't be a Dragonfire shield as you had in previous Dragon Generals.[/p][p]There is also going to be a selection of pieces of the [b]iconic[/b] Dragon armour - glorious, resplendent and [b]red, [/b]including the [b]Dragon Scimitar [/b]and the [b]Dragon Crossbow.[/b] These are earned through repeat adventures into the Scorned Wilderness - provided you're successful again.[/p][list][*][p]Added the Advanced Spinning Wheel[/p][list][*][p]Once unlocked, this will be a new processing bench in the build menu, separate from the Spinning Wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]Items that can be processed in the regular Spinning Wheel cannot be used in the Advanced Spinning Wheel.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Here's all the new items you'll be collecting:[/p][list][*][p]Runite Ore - requires Adamant Pickaxe or greater[/p][/*][*][p]Luminite Ore - requires Adamant Pickaxe or greater[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Wood - requires Rune Logging Axe or greater (the future is a mystery to us all, you know...)[/p][/*][*][p]Black Dragon Hide - crafted at the Advanced Tannery[/p][/*][*][p]Runic Powder - crafted at the Grindstone[/p][/*][*][p]Disordent Residue - dropped by enemies during the Raid.[/p][/*][*][p]Harmonised Compound - crafted in the kiln.[/p][/*][*][p]Ground Dragon Tooth - crafted at the Grindstone. [/p][/*][*][p]Vis Fibers - crafted at the Advanced Spinning Wheel[/p][/*][*][p]Draconic Vis Wax - crafted at the Brewing Cauldron.[/p][/*][*][p]Vis Cloth - crafted at the Loom using Vis Fibers and Draconic Vis Wax.[/p][/*][/list][p]Magic Tree Seeds are coming with 1.0.1 to allow you to grow your own! [/p][p]We've added a new magic weapon type... Wands! [/p][p]Wands are a more mobile, fast-paced way to deal more damage at a comparatively lower damage output. These will still apply buildup of knockdowns, burns and slows that you expect from Air, Fire and Water magic. You'll be able to use wands to move more fluidly in combat and get around, but also hang back with a Staff and lay down more damage if you want! [/p][h3]Attack[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Sprint Attacks[/b] - Unlocks the ability to perform a unique Sprint Attack after sprinting for a short distance. [/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Enchant Weapon: Water Skill Spell[/b]. Enchant your current Melee weapon with the power of Water! Strike enemies with Water damage and occasionally create healing orbs to restore your health. 15x Water + 5x Astral Runes (300s Cooldown)[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Tempest Shield Upgrade[/b] - increasing the duration of the Spell.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enchant Weapon[/b] spells have had their durations increased to 5 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tempest Shield[/b]'s base cooldown has been reduced to 45 seconds. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Ranged[/h3][list][*][p]At level 60 - increased chance for Enchanted Crossbow Bolts to trigger their effects on-hit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spectral Arrows[/b]' duration has been increased to 5 Minutes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Snare[/b]'s cooldown has been reduced to 45 seconds. [/p][/*][/list][p][i]Ranged is firmly in our sights to get some extra attention in coming updates between now and the release of Luminance this winter, so stay tuned for more to come on that.[/i][/p][h3]Magic[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Runic Refund[/b] - Grants a 30% chance to preserve your runes when attacking with magic. [/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Enfeeble[/b] - Weakens the Attacks of the targeted opponent. 20x Astral + 20x Water Runes. (75s Cooldown)[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Vengeance[/b] - Is being vindictive a virtue? I think so! A spell that reflects your enemies' damage right back at them. 20x Astral + 10x Earth Runes (60s Cooldown)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Mining[/h3][list][*][p]We've previously added the [b]Ore & Stone Storage[/b] - Unlocks the Ore and Stone Storage, a high capacity storage for ores and stones.[/p][list][*][p]They said I couldn't make a Rock and Stone reference here. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added [b]Divine Rock[/b] - Drop 5 ore on the ground and turn it into a personal mining vein. 100x Earth Rune + 100x Nature Rune (1500s Cooldown)[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Accelerated Veins[/b] - increased chance for your Divine Rocks to drop you little surprises in the form of Gems! [/p][/*][/list][h3]Woodcutting[/h3][list][*][p]In case you missed this in our previous update, we added the [b]Lumber Storage[/b] - Unlocks the Lumber Storage, a high capacity storage for logs and planks. Bet you couldn't figure that one out.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wood Weight Reduction[/b] has been moved to Level 88 - reduces the weight of wood by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Axtral Projection Upgrade[/b] - now it conjures THREE spectral axes, carving through even more trees along their path in a cone in front of you. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Construction[/h3][list][*][p]Added the Eye of Oculus Upgrade - When destroying pieces using Eye of Oculus, the eye now magnetises the recycled material into the players inventory. [/p][/*][*][p]Added New building pieces: Pets - starting with Perches for Birds.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Artisan[/h3][list][*][p]Added the [b]Storage Ledger[/b] - interact with this, and any items in your inventory that have an existing stack in any linked chest will auto-sort and be filed away correctly. Previously after a expedition you have to run around your entire base or storeroom interacting/filling stacks on every chest to unload your stuff.... now, you just walk up to the ledger and drop everything off at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Overdrive [/b]- a long requested Skill Spell. Cast on mechanical-based processing stations to empower them and boost their processing speed for a while. It's superheat, for things that aren't super hot.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved [b]Magical Mending [/b]to level 56. We've tapped down the base version of this spell's effectiveness at restoring durability to encourage using repair benches where possible, but to still make Magical Mending work in a pinch. [/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Superheat Upgrade[/b] - increasing the duration of Superheat. [/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Overdrive Upgrade[/b] - increasing the duration of Overdrive.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Magical Mending Upgrade[/b] - increased radius and durability restoration. This puts the spell slightly above where it currently sits, but feels more earned.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Runecrafting[/h3][list][*][p]Added the[b] Home Teleport[/b] spell - Teleport safely back to your claimed bed and enjoy a peaceful, undisturbed night's sleep. 15x Law Runes (900s Cooldown). [b]Yes, at last.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p]We've made significant changes to the building system! Huge builds that would previously take minutes(!!!) to load will load much faster now. So now, finally, no more long waits when teleporting back to your base! It's a new system, so if you do encounter any issues please let the team know and we'll gladly investigate! [/p][/*][*][p]We've improved LODs across the game world, and we're targeting yet another fix for these with the 1.0.1 update in October, too.[/p][/*][*][p]We've made a bunch of changes to how you move and behave in combat. These changes are broad and far-reaching, but the connecting thread across it all is that it was driven by your feedback. [/p][list][*][p]The Primary Attack button on controller will now be R1/RB/R - special attacks are now on R2/RT/ZR.[/p][/*][*][p]Let's talk camera: from the outset, we've had the camera connected very closely to the player. Your movements never strayed too far from your center of the screen. We've added a "deadzone" where you're able to freely roam the middle third of the screen before the camera starts to follow you. This lets you sprint across the world with a little more freedom in your movement and evade in combat without the camera going rogue. This should also help with Agility courses, if you're looking to do your laps. [/p][/*][*][p]Parrying will now restore 50% of your max stamina allowing you to quickly turn the tide with a burst of energy if you time it correctly - increasing the risk/reward of timing it just right. [/p][/*][*][p]The camera and parry also allow you to pull off "Visceral Attacks" - a follow-up attack that you can do when you successfully parry and enemy. The attack is optional - you can dodge, make a run for it or even throw in a Weapon Special Attack instead in that moment. Speaking of Special Attacks... [/p][/*][*][p]Special Attacks will now consume a portion of the player's [b]Special Attack Bar[/b].[/p][list][*][p]This allows us to buff these attacks and reduce their stamina costs so that they can be more powerful now that we can limit the frequency of these attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Your special attack bar will slowly recharge over time meaning players will want to ensure they time their attacks well to get the most out of their limited special attack potential![/p][/*][*][p]You will be able to use them less often, but they will feel more powerful with each use. Things like the Titan's Wrath and the Greatsword Special will hit harder, and be more of an active ability choice.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sprint attacks have been added to the game, allowing you to open with a big strike once you've levelled up your Attack skill a little. You'll be able to open a combo with a strong hit - but that's not all...[/p][/*][*][p]You'll be able to cancel attacks, gathering and spell-casting actions with dodging and blocking.[/p][list][*][p]This means you can opt out of those pesky wind-ups or spells you've committed to mid-combat. But if you don't want to cancel the spell - you can now move while casting a range of spells, including Enchant Weapon, Windstep and Surge as just a few examples. Use that new-found window of opportunity to buff yourself, catch a breath and dive back in to the fray.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Skill Spell wheel now has 4 hotkeys that let you auto-cast the first four choices in the Radial Menu. These are mapped to the triggers, allowing you to open the wheel and instantly trigger the respective spell.[/p][/*][*][p]Remember to use the Spellbook in the menu to re-order these spells to fit your muscle memory! Rocksplosion, my beloved,[/p][/*][*][p]We're also still investigating how we can introduce a dedicated quick-cast button for a particular spell or item in a future update.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Feather Fall" special ability has been removed from the Leggings of Lightness, for balance and maintenance reasons. We replaced it with an ability that makes Windstep cost zero runes to cast while the Leggings are equipped. The Leggings still also grant extra carry weight capacity as before.[/p][/*][*][p]In case you missed it in 0.12.1 - Ammunition can now be swapped on the D-Pad or Scroll Wheel. Flip between Runes or Arrow Types depending on your equipped weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]The Abyssal Whip now requires a recipe found in the Umbral Sands to complete to unlock its Masterwork Weapon potential. In the interim, you'll be able to craft the [b]Abysmal Whip (PL4)[/b] as an intermediary weapon which will not have the Special Attack, with a marginal tap-down in damage. Upgrading to the Masterwork Abyssal Whip elevates the weapon to [b]PL7.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Due to overwhelming demand, Ava'a Accumulator no longer makes sound when equipped. Shut the cluck up. [/p][/*][*][p]With the launch on Consoles, some Smart TVs may attempt to hard-force Game/HDR picture settings within the TV itself. For some users, this may seem to be extra bloom-y or brighter than expected. We'd encourage users to check their TV's Picture Settings and lower the following three settings to suit your preferences: [/p][list][*][p]Contrast[/p][/*][*][p]Colour[/p][/*][*][p]and, if applicable - Contrast Enhancer. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We rolled out a range of fixes for navigation through menu systems and crafting stations, both for Controller and Keyboard and Mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips can now be scrolled through.[/p][/*][*][p]The Quest Menu sidebar can be collapsed to view the Map fully.[/p][/*][*][p]Active Lodestones are now visible on the map, not just the lodestone menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Map icons now grow in size when hovered over.[/p][/*][*][p]Map icons now have a small tooltip when hovered.[/p][/*][*][p]Moderation was added too! You can now report problematic worlds, rude players, griefers and hackers. Reports are fully moderated by real human beings - no AI involved - and can lead to temporary world and player bans.[/p][/*][*][p]We've tweaked the damage of the Dire Wolves and Garou of Ghornfell to be marginally less terrifying, while you're trying to establish a foothold in the second area.[/p][list][*][p]Dig your heels in and fight them! [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]With launch we'll be sharing a Known Issues live page that we'll be updating throughout the week with Vital Information of issues we're tracking! But, just as a cool statistic - in the process of securing our 1.0 build, going gold and launching onto consoles, the team found, logged and fixed 2,665 bugs. Two thousand, six hundred and sixty five. Yep! So many of these you'll never see, wooshed away - like magic![/p][p]For now, here's what Community-driven fixes we're deploying today.[/p][list][*][p]Fix to Fuzan occasionally getting stuck at 0hp in the Fight Caves and fail to respawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged ammo drops from will once again magnetize to the player as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]The Nightmare Crucible did not end correctly when completed if the player had summoned a Buddy. [/p][/*][*][p]The Red Desert Cape Vestige is now correctly included in the Drop Table.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for users who encountered a blocker when interacting with Chests, particularly in Dowdun Reach, that didn't work when interacted with on another player's world.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Tree Canopies would not disappear when the tree was felled.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to reduce the probability of trees failing to topple when felled. [/p][/*][*][p]Building over cliff edges no longer causes the player to be met with rapidly changing weather.[/p][/*][*][p]Single axe swings will no longer be able to both split a tree and remove the stump, to avoid accidental stump removals! [/p][/*][*][p]Decorative Gems are now able to be placed on Foundations and Flooring.[/p][/*][*][p]Players on mounts can now eat or drink from the hot bar as well as the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where dying to the Kalphite Queen in certain circumstances would cause the Gravestone to be stuck in the arena, instead of spawning outside the entrance.[/p][/*][*][p]The Water Barrel, Rain Catcher and Compost Bin's "Hold to Delete" button has been reverted to a one-tap delete. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Kothaar and Kalphite damage values to scale correctly with the Hard Mode Difficulty option.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue affecting the Trunk Totems leaving some unable to be destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]The Roof on the Yew Farming Plots no longer blocks the Humidify Skill Spell from reaching other plots.[/p][/*][*][p]Watermelon Jerky's maximum stack value has been raised from 50 to 99.[/p][/*][*][p]The Bow of Elidinis can no longer use Bleed, Poison and Fire Arrows.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Watch This Space[/h1][p]From today, until the 4th October, you can earn yourself the Dragonwilds Twitch Badge! Tune in to your favourite streamer and watch 30 minutes of RuneScape: Dragonwilds to earn yourself a badge for your Twitch account to wear with pride! [/p][p]This is not the end of RuneScape: Dragonwilds. A new chapter begins with this release, and the start of an ambitious, multi-year journey into Ashenfall and its secrets. This winter, we'll be shipping Luminance, our next Content Update which will bring a new building kit, and so much more alongside it. And as for changes to combat on the horizon? Well, let's just say... Magic [b][i]rocks[/i][/b]. Literally. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564297/1eec45f340bbe3c43b8399fb6b1510ebc694a1c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You know the usual - follow our socials ([url="https://x.com/RSDragonwilds"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/rsdragonwilds.bsky.social"]BSky[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/rsdragonwilds/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/RuneScapeDragonwilds"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/RSDragonwilds"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@RSDragonwilds"]YouTube [/url]and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@rsdragonwilds"]TikTok[/url]!) and get involved with [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/RSDragonwilds/"]Reddit [/url]and join the [url="https://discord.gg/rsdragonwilds"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]As always, we love seeing your comments and feedback, and we're very excited to see you taking on everything Ashenfall has to offer. Thank you for being part of this historic moment in RuneScape's history. We cannot wait to share more with you soon.[/p]
items.author: Mod Doom

items.title: Dragonwilds Is Leaving Early Access. Our Price Isn't.
items.contents: [p]Since we launched into Early Access, we've been extremely proud of the amazing work that has gone into RuneScape: Dragonwilds. So many of you have taken the plunge into Ashenfall, and with every update we are humbled by the number of you trying out Dragonwilds, recommending it to friends and leaving reviews on Steam. The feedback has been incredible, and the game continues to improve with every update, guided and informed by our vision, and your feedback, working together in harmony.[/p][p]RuneScape: Dragonwilds is not stopping at our 1.0 release, and we will continue to deliver monthly updates to you as the game grows.[/p][h1]The game, containing the entirety of Kuldra's Saga and the Free Updates around it, [b]is staying the same price once 1.0 releases[/b]. £24.99, or $29.99. [/h1][p]Dragonwilds' success is because of the invaluable participation of our Early Access players, but also thanks to the support and excitement shared by the countless number of fans waiting for Kuldra's Saga to be complete before you took the plunge with us. We hope this small gesture goes some way to showing our endless appreciation for your support and belief.[/p][p]We'll also be launching our next Update in the coming Winter - one we're naming [b]Luminance[/b]. This, much like the minor updates, is free, too. We'll share more about our 2027 plans once we've delivered our 1.0 release, and you can tune into our Summit at RuneFest on October 3rd, to hear more about 2027 and the next Saga in Ashenfall's story.[/p]

items.title: Kuldra's Saga - An Update From Mod Dutch
items.contents: [h2]Hello Adventurers![/h2][p]It is I, Mod Dutch, come to you with a message about the future of Dragonwilds. Hold on, sheath that sword, ease your bowstring and pause casting that water spell, I assure you, it is good news![/p][h2]TL;DR: Our 1.0 release on September 15th is not the end of Dragonwilds. Far from it.[/h2][p]Ever since it became clear that there was high enthusiasm for a survival game set in the RuneScape franchise, we’ve been diligently planning (oftentimes cackling with glee) what comes next. Mod Rook, our intrepid Creative Director, together with Mod Raven, envisioned a satisfying wrap-up to the story of the Dragon Queen Kuldra to coincide with our game exiting Early Access, so that RuneScape and survival fans who had been holding off until this point, could experience the complete story from beginning to end.[/p][p]At Jagex we look at our RuneScape titles as ongoing projects, always. They are never done, because they continuously evolve. That has been the way for twenty-five years of adventuring on Gielinor. Changes, fixes, overhauls, new content, amazing new sagas, new raids, new bosses, new quest areas – it’s a continuous flow of updates, informed by the players’ opinions and feedback. This is deeply ingrained in the DNA of Jagex.[/p][p]Given that we’re always adapting our plans and figuring out the best way to get great content into the hands of our fans and potential new players, we see development of Dragonwilds as a long voyage with many epic stages, many cycles, and many sagas. It is the one big thing that thrills us so much about this being a RuneScape game – there are always more new features to develop, more homages to pay, more stories to tell.[/p][p]I recently spoke about the future of Dragonwilds in the Runefest 2026 Preview Livestream. You can find it on [url="https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2826225990?t=01h28m13s"]Twitch[/url], at the 1 hour and 28 minutes mark.[/p][p]Let me reiterate here (paraphrased), what I said there, because it is easy for a message to get lost in a livestream covering multiple games:[/p][p]Shipping into 1.0 is a major milestone for us because it concludes the Kuldra Saga with the players going into the Scorned Wilderness raid and defeating her.[/p][p]It is the end of [b][i]her[/i][/b] story but it’s not the end of the story of Ashenfall and how it is [b][i]still[/i][/b] hidden and unknowable to the rest of Gielinor. It [b][i]could[/i][/b] be a new frontier of civilization, but its ancient magics still block that. This is where we are going to develop our story further and it is going to be a multi-year journey.[/p][p]More information will be revealed closer to launch, with even more coming at Runefest in October.[/p][p]In short: yes, the game world will grow in the future, yes there will be more of everything coming (skills, quests, regions, bosses, enemies, rewards), as we continue into this unexplored stretch of the Sixth Age - and beyond. [/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates.[/p][h3]Mod Dutch[/h3]

items.title: 0.12.1 is now live!
items.contents: [h1]Agility[/h1][p]With the 0.12.1 release, we're delighted to be introducing a long-overdue addition to RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Agility! Our latest skill will allow you to build up your stamina and sculpt yourself into a speed machine.  Across Ashenfall, you'll find SIX new stations with flags for you to interact with. There, you'll find a leaderboard of times, and a trail of orbs to gather along a fixed course. From there, you'll be able to continually repeat the courses over and over, improving your time, getting XP with every lap.[/p][p]You'll earn rewards for completing Agility courses, and mastery of the courses will net you Gold Medals. You can throw those on your walls, like Pristine Fish from Fishing, as trophies to show everyone who's the boss of the course. Mastering the region's agility course will also grant you a gilded trimmed version of the regional cape as an extra reward.[/p][p]Firstly, let's talk about passives: [/p][p]You'll be able to gain XP passively while running across the world, too - but you won't get XP on mounts. Stop cheating and get those knees up! As you level up through the Agility Skill tree, you will passively consume less Stamina while you sprint. [/p][p]At levels 50 and 75, you'll also unlock passive increases to your maximum carry weight. [/p][p]You'll also be able to use Agility Shortcuts to make use of Kebbit Burrows situated across the world. They'll be dotted on your map, and you can dig them up to open up tunnels to cut across side routes in the world. In early Agility levels, you might take damage when failing to squeeze through unharmed, so be careful using the shortcuts on low HP.[/p][p]At higher levels, you'll start to break your falls from higher up by rolling out of them to avoid taking as much damage. Fatal falls will still kill you though. [/p][p]The skill tree also, of course, comes with its own Skill Spells and unlocks.[/p][p]Windstep is now an Agility skill spell, rather than a Runecrafting skill spell.[/p][p]At higher levels, Windstep will also cause you to send out a blast of air when you land, sending enemies to the floor.[/p][p]So, you can run further, carry more and scoot across the world in shortcuts. But that's being fast - not agile.[/p][p]How about... an aerial dash? A short, horizontal dash to cross small gaps and add extra evasive manoeuvres during combat? [/p][p]Sounds good. What if we gave you... a second jump? You'll be able to jump, jump again in mid-air and then dash horizontally to get over and around enemies. Pretty cool, right?[/p][p]You'll also be able to use a new skill spell - [i][b]Recall[/b][/i].[/p][p]Leave a runic marker on the ground, and then recast to teleport back to the initial marking spot - great for quickly grabbing something urgently and getting out of danger. If you fall to your death while tethered, you'll also teleport back, and the tether will be consumed. [/p][p]All of this is built to make you faster, leaner and meaner - and we'll be factoring it in moving forwards in how we design exploration, puzzles and more. So don't start thinking you'll be able to make an Agility Pure account - it's time to do some cardio.[/p][h2]The Great Body Robbery[/h2][p]Our longest Secondary Quest to date can be found in Bloodblight Swamp - an unfortunate experiment has rendered the Good* Doctor* Fenkenstrain in a bit of a pickle. You'll need to help him out. Your rewards are a new club weapon that's shockingly good, and a buildable decoration: the Pylon. This functional decoration will generate an area of effect in a radius around it that intercepts lightning strikes to allow you to build in places known for... inclement weather. [/p][p][i]* = The validity of this claim is highly disputed.[/i][/p][h2]Combat and Movement Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]We're introducing the Ascension Cores feature to the Mystic Forge - use those cores to upgrade Masterwork and Vestige weapons to higher tiers using the relevant cores![/p][/*][*][p]We're adding a radial hotwheel for both Controller and Keyboard + Mouse users to speed up selecting primary items, as well as adding the quick cast shortcut for either a spell OR an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Stability changes are coming to make jumping more consistent in suboptimal networking conditions that led to losing the ability to jump in some circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]You'll be able to cycle through your runes/arrows in mid combat to save you having to open your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping will cost 10 stamina, down from 20 - reducing further when Agility levels are reached.[/p][list][*][p]Leggings of Lightness, Mounts and Windstep should each be unaffected by this, so your general mobility won't change![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We're making good progress on improving performance, additional ambient VFX and tons of optimisation for Fog, trees, grass and even the coastline. All of that is intended to make the experience more stable/smooth for you to focus on what you do best. Smacking the living daylights out of goblins.[/p][/*][*][p]We're also adding more to the existing jump to improve its "ledge forgiveness" - as in, if you walk off a ledge, there's a small window of time for you to jump before you cartoonishly plummet to your demise. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Visual Fidelity[/h2][p]We've done a bit of a pass over the starting areas (Brynmoor and Ghornfell) with an emphasis on visual improvements, performance and clarity. We've improved how trees will look nicer at a distance, the visual clarity of moss and fog, our existing grass and foliage to include more flowers, and we've improved performance at lower ends of the settings.[/p][p]We've revisited night sky visuals, volumetric fog across the world, storm weather visuals and we've also added additional ambient VFX across the region and along the coastline. [/p][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]Power Level 7 (PL7) Shards do [u][b]not[/b][/u] exist in the World, but the recipe to convert PL7 Shards to Cores does exist in the Mystic Forge. This is [u][i][b]not intentional.[/b][/i][/u] We will be removing the recipe with our 1.0 update.[/p][/*][*][p]PL7 Cores are [u][i][b]only[/b][/i][/u] obtained from the Nightmare Crucible [b]directly[/b] and not through converting shards.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]We're resolving an issue where Axes were dealing incorrect damage to trees. [/p][list][*][p]We misplaced a decimal. Oops! [/p][/*][*][p]We'll be reverting this to its intended value with 0.12.1, alongside several other bugfixes to woodcutting, including Splinter and Axetral Projection removing stumps.[/p][/*][*][p]This was giving people disproportionate XP based on the damage dealt - we're putting values back to where they should be! [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Axtral Projection upgrades would not chop down all intended/highlighted trees.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Splinter would destroy tree stumps if used on an adjacent log.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Yew Farming Plots did not snap in building modes correctly. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rune Vents would appear full for clients in multiplayer worlds even when depleted. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue introduced in Umbral Sands where game music would loop repeatedly, primarily triggered upon respawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an bug where summoning Buddy in a wall would cause the game to crash. [/p][list][*][p]Get it? Bug? Becau- oh, forget it. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where a part of the Burning Spire zone where the player could fall through Lava. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where returning to the main menu after dying would respawn the player back at the location of death. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Potion Effects would be removed between game sessions/on logout. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Lodestone teleports placed on the edges of the map could only be used one-way as they would fail to be displayed on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the search area on the map for the "Saga of the Adventurer" Quest Step was incorrectly aligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Wild Jade Vines would die to poison in the Toxic Swamp. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Ascension Cores weren't displayed correctly in the Mystic Forge of the crafting menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the TokTz-Mej-Tal staff would not consume runes on attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some items would display a white square placeholder depiction.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Right Stick on controllers would not turn the camera within a 30% radius in some contexts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some shaded areas would let Scorch stack up to 500% without triggering.[/p][list][*][p]That's probably going to leave a mark.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tweaked the lighting in the Velgar Arena to improve visibility when fighting him at night.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Spellwheel would not show descriptions for spells as a client in Multiplayer worlds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fire Cape would refill Stamina even if the enemy was not afflicted with burns.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kharidian Inner Corner 45° Stairs would be unclimbable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could walk under a specific Sand Dune.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an Air Anima vent was situated inside a pillar within the Umbral Sands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Chamber barrier in the Contact! quest would be invisible at very low, low and medium graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Special Attack of Hammer weapons which could stunlock Lesser Dragons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Shrimp Catcher" quest completion would not contribute to the Achievement "Brynmoor Helper".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen would respawn in an invisible state after being defeated. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen's Sting Attack would become angulated. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the dunes behind the Kalphite Queen Vault had missing collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ground atop the Cave of Screams was missing collission. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there was a small invisible barrier blocking pathing in the Dunes of Uzzer when moving on foot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Quicksand and its VFX were showing in areas that weren't actually quicksand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a Sanguine Urn icon was incorrectly placed in the Bloodblight Swamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where users could get stuck in a small spot in the Burning Spire. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Desert Weed did not have any healthy growth stage assets when planted. It looks as healthy as it is, now![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where part of a rock surface in the Burning Spire would behave like lava and damage the player when walking on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Menaphite Desert Cape was missing a Journal Entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Rapid Growth Skill Spell had a placeholder icon in the Spellbook[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where collision remained on the Zi Core quest item after it had been collected. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Korean Subtitles were not showing correctly during the opening cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Skills Necklace has an unclear description in the interface. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Localised text for the Construction Skill bonuses was not displayed correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where completing a quest for Lagra, Alcarrid's Butcher would not yield rewards if the player's inventory was full.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Yew Shortbow when fully drawn back causing visual clutter. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fishing Minigame could not have the keybinds rebound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bones to Peaches would not mention the stack limit is limited to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Blue Dragon was incorrectly labelled as "Lesser Blue Dragon" instead.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Stamina would instantly regenerate after jumping when wearing the full set of Wizard Robes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with a typo in the Hall of Heroes Journal Entry. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Miniaturized Mushrooms in the Dunes of Uzzer could not be gathered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Torches in the doorways in Umbral Sands were unnaturally bright. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where attempting to cast Fishnado on a Net Fishing Spot would show an incorrect error message: "Your fish has escaped!" [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Green Dragons' flame attack VFX were items.title: New Drops - Through Adversity, to the Stars
items.contents: [p]Greetings, Flameborn![/p][p][/p][p]As is the tradition, with every update comes a new vanity outfit! As the nights get longer (if you're on the correct side of the planet, sorry players from down under), we get more time to stay in, look at the stars, and play video games. What if there was a way to combine all three activities? Enters the [b]Artificer set[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]There are five parts of the set to find hidden in Embervale, and you can speak with Mei-Yin Chen to unlock the hints for the set in your journal tab! (EDIT: In order to get the first hint, players have to have Mei unlocked, have Loraine Crim unlocked, and have all Beacon Dungeons done (as well as not having started or finished the Set yet)[/p][p]If you'd like to add a touch of sophistication to your builds, there are also two new props to craft: the Star Map and Ancient Globe! Their recipes will be unlocked through the sidequest "Find the Orrery Rings"![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/242d74743e822d6475360424f5abc8b9a15c4e4b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Busy exploring elsewhere? These rewards can also be earned as Twitch Drops, starting on [b]November 3rd, at 3pm CET[/b].[/p][p]Here’s how the loot drops as you watch:[/p][list][*][p]⏱ [b]30 mn[/b]– Artificer Boots & Trousers[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]60 mn [/b]– Artificer Gloves[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]90 mn[/b]– Artificer Hope Chest[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]120 mn[/b] – Star Map[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]180 mn[/b] – Artificer Helmet[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]240 mn[/b] – Animated Ancient Globe[/p][/*][/list][p]For all the details — plus a handy countdown — head over to our Twitch Drops page:[/p][p][url="https://twitch.enshrouded.com/en-US"]https://twitch.enshrouded.com/en-US[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like your favorite streamers to take part in the Twitch drops campaign, remember: all you have to do is ask them nicely![/p]

items.title: Changelog for Patch #1
items.contents: [p][/p][h1]Changelog for Patch #1, aka Patch 1.0.1.0[/h1][p]Version is:  1283531  [/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Bosses now stay engaged in combat longer after having been attacked and even when players are far away. Previously, ranged fights against bosses such as the Fell Monstrosity could be frustrating when the boss suddenly started to recover health even while being shot at.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with both the Wispwyvern and its undead counterpart that they couldn’t get targeted correctly by totem spells and other summons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Dragon Youngling that could cause a state where it was defeated but did not trigger the correct dead state. What is dead may never die something something give me my loot![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that boss music could stop while the fight was still ongoing.[/p][/*][*][p]Ancient S.P.D.R. Constructs can now be lured less easily into a spot where they forget how to move or how to attack.[/p][/*][*][p]The shielded Ancient Construct now has phases where the shield is on cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the poison damage from the Fell Vinebloom's area attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could lead to a Vukah Brawler spawning inside the cave wall. [/p][/*][*][p]Made it easier to target enemies next to Cyclopses. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Scavenger Bully's retaliation attack showing “Not effective” when hitting the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the combat behavior of vultures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with the visuals of the artillery attacks of both the Wispwyvern and its undead counterpart.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue for the tar spit of Snapjaws.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the visuals for the Fell Shackled Banshee when it was defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]The projectiles from Fell Vines now hit props and terrain as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the explosion radius of the Scavenger proximity mines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that sometimes defeated enemies had to be interacted with twice before it was possible to loot them.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cases of Fell enemies that have no loot. Another fix for this is planned for the next update.[/p][/*][*][p]Elite flying critters now give more XP when defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of flying critters in one location in the Kindlewaste Hollow Hall.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the size of the combat collider for the Fell mini critters. Previously, they could block arrows when trying to shoot enemies behind them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where the level of enemies didn’t fit the level of the region.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed timing issues with the mysterious wanderer's appearances. [/p][/*][*][p]Sprint can now be set to toggle in the keyboard & mouse settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand attack frequency can't be unnaturally boosted anymore by animation-cancelling each shot via blocking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the Lupa's scalper daggers not to enable the riposte kick ability when wielded.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the stamina costs for Whirlwind Crescendo.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the mana costs for the Wand Evasion Attack.[/p][/*][*][p]The Aerial Wand Attack now costs 40 mana instead of stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the perk descriptions for mana, health and stamina leech where necessary.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing sounds to the Wand Heavy Attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few food options to the path before and in the first cave to avoid starvation before reaching the first wider area.[/p][/*][*][p]Purple berries are now easier to spot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed water wheels not rotating correctly even though they had contact with moving water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several incorrect enemies spawned by the Sparkworks enemy spawners.[/p][/*][*][p]Props that are part of a Sparkworks setup can no longer be destroyed by attacks from either players or enemies. They can still be dismantled, though.[/p][/*][*][p]Snapping to trees has been improved when using the wood chopping axe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that the Chain Heal spell can also heal enemy Hollow skeletons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a link to the news section on [url="https://enshrouded.com"]enshrouded.com[/url] to the main menu. So that you can read news about updates such as this one. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI issue when chatting while fast travelling. Previously, entering text in the chat while fast travelling could lead to the incorrect opening of inventory tabs. [/p][/*][*][p]Unlocking perks on items that increase a skill level now shows the correct UI icon when opening the skill tree immediately after the upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases of yellow “is new” markers not disappearing from items in the inventory. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI layout issue in the “search with share code” window in the adventure sharing menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI layout issue in the Sparkworks trigger configuration sliders when the text size was set to 80%.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the background darker for the mapmarker filter overlay so that the icons are easier to see.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the item detail menu for torches would show them as upgradable, which they are not. [/p][/*][*][p]Inanimate objects that can be destroyed now have a grey “health” bar to make it clear that they take damage but are not a threat. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the “health” of several Ancient props that broke too easily. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a name and description switcheroo for the two armor sets Ashwind Strider and Sky Specter. [/p][/*][*][p]Added two more craftable versions of lore weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some minor changes to crafting recipes: crab cakes now accept any type of milk, the goo recipe now also unlocks by picking up the Shroud mushroom resource from Revelwoods and the big farm animal beds can now be crafted using any wood type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing tab in the controller button layout popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where the selection of a list would jump to the top or bottom, but the scrollbar didn’t follow correctly. This was noticeable in the survivor menu, for example.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sparkworks tutorial now correctly opens at the Sparkworks workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum number of characters for the name of a world is now the same again as it was during the early access phase.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sparkworks workbench is now showing up in the workshops overview menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several improvements to the factories page in the player base overview menu. Sorting by name now works as intended. Also, sorting by remaining production time or by the product has been added as new sorting values. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI layout of the building Finetune Mode widget. It is now also easier to see when the mode is active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor issues with text overlapping its menu areas in different languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several minor issues with armor items and cloth movement.[/p][/*][*][p]The settings for hiding armor in specific equipment slots are now also represented in the character renderings in pre-game menus. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several missing greetings and farewells from survivors. [/p][/*][*][p]Survivors now push grass while walking just as players do.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the volume of several survivor voice-over lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Voice-over lines are now easier to understand compared to other sounds coming from the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the sound mixing for surround setups. Work on this continues and more issues will be fixed in the next patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up some voice-over files that contained outtakes from the recording. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor animation issues with survivors during the conversations.[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese or German is now selected correctly as the voice-over language for the intro and outro when selecting the system language setting in one of these two languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors can no longer be pushed when their roaming distance is set to 0.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that it could happen that lootable objects still offered the loot interaction in the player base even though the lootable object was no longer available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with fish preventing reproduction of other animals. They were secretly occupying beds needed for the new offspring in the farm.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the prop placement finetune mode could remain active when switching to non-fine-tunable items like the summoning staff, magic staffs or certain props like water dispensers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented players from removing overgrowth from buildings in their base.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to destroy props with the pickaxe in the flying build mode.[/p][/*][*][p]When in flying build mode, the sounds that are heard are now those at the position of the camera, not where the character model is located.[/p][/*][*][p]When receiving damage while in flying build mode, the flying mode is now immediately cancelled. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused some building shapes to show incorrect materials in small areas.[/p][/*][*][p]The previous update unfortunately unlocked all hairstyles in the character creation menu, even the hairstyles that are quest rewards. This has been fixed. Players who created a character with one of the erroneously accessible hairstyles may of course keep their hair and the hairstyle is counted as unlocked in the item set. [/p][/*][*][p]Added the previously missing muted purple hair color to the item set.[/p][/*][*][p]Azure Russula seedlings are now a bit cheaper to produce in the farmbeed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with factories using a default material instead of the selected material when a recipe allows several alternatives.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored some visual effects on terrain materials, such as mud bubbles. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed basalt as loot from several terrain and block materials as it could lead to some recipes unlocking too early in the progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some texture issues for placeable Ancient props.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed texture issues for several placeable secret doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that when fast travelling to a location with sand or snow, there would sometimes be the appearance of strange holes in the ground. [/p][/*][*][p]Rocks no longer chase the player when running past them with auto-loot enabled. They are now picked up instead. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few smaller game world issues such as tents stuck too far in the ground or incorrectly flooded cellars.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some grappling hook anchors that didn’t work as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the position of a Hollow enemy spawn point in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect foliage effects when chopping bamboo. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved several cases of sound reverb.[/p][/*][*][p]While the voice chat is set to open microphone, the microphone can now be muted or unmuted via a toggle keybinding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that skills and attacks could stop working correctly after playing for several hours. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved stability in multiplayer when hosting a world with very large player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a cause of flickering shadows in very large player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect dark areas in regions such as desert sand in certain graphical settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to outdated position information for tombstones.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few randomly occurring crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential crash that could happen when closing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several loca issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]PC-specific[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several cases that could cause a save data migration to trigger an error. If a save file caused migration issues before, please try the migration again with this update.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the memory budget for the total sum of all player bases during the save data migration. This fix only affects save data with too many player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the 3d resolution scale slider to show 100% after a reset, even if the preset for the detected graphics card uses a default that is below 100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a keybinding issue where binding evade to \[RMB]+\[SPACE] would perform a jump instead of the evade action. This fix could also help in similar key binding combinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the \[ESC] key to no longer work correctly in-game after using the AMD overlay tool. [/p][/*][*][p]Added new graphical settings for AMD graphics cards. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a randomly occurring crash on GPUs.[/p][/*][/list]
items.author: CoolUsernameBro
items.summary:
• Aggiunta la modalità scatto alternabile, nuove impostazioni grafiche per GPU AMD, opzioni di creazione e funzioni di microfono.
• Migliorato il comportamento dei boss, bilanciati i costi di mana e stamina e aggiunte opzioni di cibo iniziale.
• Ottimizzata la stabilità del multiplayer per basi grandi, risolto il rendering delle ombre e migliorata la migrazione dei salvataggi.
• Corretti diversi bug relativi a interfaccia utente, audio, grafica, sistema di costruzione, comportamenti dei sopravvissuti e crash improvvisi.
