items.title: Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.3
items.contents:
[h1]Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.3[/h1][p]Version is:  1273043[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Some users who were missing Early Access rewards now correctly have them redeemable in the game’s pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several crashes connected to the water simulation. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several crashes that could occur when leaving the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several randomly occurring crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when interacting with factories.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when unlocking new recipes while a filter was active for the recipe list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash that could occur during the save data migration process. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the save data migration process in case a character has invalid entries in the additional backpack slots. Characters should now migrate correctly, without the items that previously caused the process to stop.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the save data migration process for cases when the Flame Altar was not placed in the voxel grid for unknown reasons. The migration process now corrects the position of the Flame Altar within the grid. Unfortunately, in these cases, the affected player base's water can’t be loaded and must be re-added as needed. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused some light flickering in very large player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused an endless black screen for some players when trying to load a multiplayer game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved a stuttering issue in the game when using V-Sync on AMD graphics cards.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p]

items.title: Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.2
items.contents:
[h1]Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.2[/h1][p]Version is:  1269579[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented configuring world settings. It was introduced accidentally in the previous hotfix while we fixed the misbehaving session lists in the multiplayer join menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash during save game migration. The crash previously occurred when trying to load a corrupted character save. With this hotfix, such corrupted characters will not be migrated. We are working on a fix that will allow migration and fix the corrupted characters simultaneously. So, if you are missing a character in your character list in the current version, please be patient - help is on the way![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a strange-looking rendering issue where the game looks like it’s in a very dense grey fog… but not nice and spooky like the Shroud. It appeared only on Nvidia graphics cards, and manifested particularly often in the Hollow Halls, which were just too spooky.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with factories crashing in rare cases when being placed down or failing to show the correct menu when interacting with them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization issues in the skill tree with the skills Aerial Wand Attack, Evasion Attack, Wand Evasion Attack and Crash Down Attack in several languages. Further skill descriptions are on their way in the next patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when fast traveling or landing with a glider in a world with a lot of entities, such as enemies, survivors, mannequins, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the stability of Adventure Share subscribing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur while browsing shared adventures or starting a download.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several rare and randomly occurring crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several rare crashes connected to the water simulation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could lead to the server crashing when fighting a very large number of enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash that could occur in connection with the Twitch link server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash that only appeared when playing with a completely filled backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential crashes that could occur while exiting the game. [/p][/*][/list][p]
That's it for today! If you encounter more issues, please get in touch with our support team [url="https://enshrouded.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new"]through this link[/url], and make sure to check for a response e-mail asking for details and specific files for investigation! Thank you for helping us make Enshrouded better for everyone.[/p]
items.author: CoolUsernameBro

items.title: Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.1
items.contents: [h1]Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.1[/h1][p]Version number is: 1267041[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed several issues that could cause random crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a dynamic lighting issue that caused indoor brightness problems. [/p][/*][*][p]The “Fire Wisp” scroll now has a fixed level 27. Previously, the damage scaled with the player level, which made the scroll ridiculously strong in the end-game. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the artbook and world map available in the Deluxe Upgrade Pack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes caused by specific peripherals attached to the PC.[/p][/*][/list][p]Note:[/p][p]We are observing an issue with sound, specifically reverb in large halls or rooms and with the dynamically lowered gameplay sounds while lore voice-over is playing. The issue only appears when the master volume slider is lower than 100%. Until we have a fix, it is recommended to keep the master volume slider at 100% and regulate the volume in the Windows sound settings instead, if needed.[/p][p][/p][p]IMPORTANT:[/p][p]We've noticed an issue that cropped up with this hotfix. If you're trying to edit your world right now and the edit button doesn't work, try subscribing to something (anything) in adventure sharing, and then try editing your world again. That appears to be a temporary workaround while we fix it. Sorry for the inconvinience![/p]

items.title: Enshrouded 1.0 is LIVE! Check out our Highlights video!
items.contents: [p]Greetings Flameborn! [/p][p][/p][p]So obviously we released the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1203620/announcements/detail/687519694976975215"]changelog yesterday[/url], but we've also made the traditional Highlights video for those of you who only believe it when you see it![/p][p][/p][p]Please take a look: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/3McXzuyaji8?si=CJl_cop01v9yRrSm"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Enshrouded is live! It helps potential new players know whether Enshrouded is for them![/p][p][/p][p]Have fun in Embervale, Flameborn, and we'll see you very soon![/p][p][/p][p]The team at Keen Games.[/p]

items.title: Release trailer, changelog... everything you need to wait for tomorrow!
items.contents:
[p]Greetings, Flameborn!

We'll keep this brief: Enshrouded releases tomorrow! We'll help you wait for the last day or so with an early release of our release trailer, as well as our complete changelog!

Check out our sweet trailer:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/gp7PZXkyxxY?si=kozk3DY1Cw43rzLC"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]

And here are the changelog's highlights. 


[/p][h1]Highlights[/h1][p]
[/p][h2][b]Finally, a full map to explore![/b][/h2][p]The full release 1.0 of Enshrouded finally lets players explore all the hidden valleys and majestic mountains of Embervale. Up in the north, beyond the now open gates past the Veilwater Basin a completely new area can be explored, the Cinder’s Cradle. Cinder's Cradle has two sides. Below, lava flows through a barren wasteland littered with the ruins of a mysterious past, some areas lost to the Shroud, others lost to time and decay. But the player's journey doesn’t end here - above the lava and ruins, the Ancients have lifted the earth to create a realm of floating islands filled with unusual fauna, intricate architecture, and unrelenting guardians. Both worlds are connected through tendrils of the Shroud, reaching ever higher to snuff out a sacred light in the Ancient midsts. [/p][p]Whilst exploring Cinder’s Cradle, a brand new threat is standing in the player’s path. Bring your best gear, upgrade it, cook the most efficient food before testing your mettle against these new formidable guardians of the last secrets of Embervale.[/p][p]However, the new biome is only a part of the now complete new map. [/p][p]Two new Hollow Halls have opened their gates, one in the Albaneve Summits and one in Veilwater Basin - bring your snorkel. [/p][p]Many new areas have been added to Springlands, Blackmire and Kindlewastes specifically. These new areas expand the previous playable areas towards the edges of the world. While not as densely filled with points of interest as the central areas, they still offer many surprises and rewards for explorers - including new Shroud roots for those who need the extra skillpoints. [/p][p]As part of the main quest through the new areas, players will visit structures in the previous biomes, some of which had players wonder and desperately look for a hidden entrance for years. The time to investigate what was hidden behind these doors is now![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bring hope to a broken world[/b][/h2][p]Players finally discover the mysteries behind the Ancients and the deadly Shroud corruption - and, if all goes well, put an end to the plans that threaten all of Embervale. But it will not be easy; high up in the sky, evil is hiding its strongest champion yet. [/p][p]With update 1.0.0.0, the story of Embervale is concluded - for now. Even after dealing with the most imminent threat, the Shroud still lingers and the Fell still aim to conquer more territories. But the survivors in Embervale will now have a new sense of hope for this world - and a new inspiration to thrive, flourish and rebuild the realm. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]New levels of power[/b][/h2][p]Together with the new region, a new tier of progression is unlocked. The new maximum level for the player is 50; gear can now be upgraded to a maximum level of 55.[/p][p]Before entering the Cinder’s Cradle, the next Flame Level is waiting to be unlocked - which in turn will raise the maximum of Flame Altars to 15. Rumors have it that besting the biggest threat to the peace of Embervale will unlock yet another level of the Flame - with even greater might to push back the Shroud - enabling Flame Altars to shine in areas formerly unreachable. [/p][p]A new survivor, specializing in Ancient knowledge and recipes, joins the base. [/p][p]As with previous biomes, a new tier of crafting progression can be explored and over time unlocked with new equipment, tools, food and other consumables, arrows, spells, giving players the level of power needed on the new battlefield. [/p][p]The comforts back at home are certainly not forgotten; new furniture, props, building blocks and plants are unlocked as well.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hey, listen![/b][/h2][p]All lore notes, letters, books and other texts found in the world are now fully voiced in English, German and Mandarin Chinese. [/p][p]Players can continue exploring while listening to lore notes (like an audiobook) - playback of multiple notes can be queued in a playlist. [/p][p]But it’s not just the books that talk now; all main crafting survivors and major quest-giver survivors are also now voiced in English, German and Mandarin Chinese! Perhaps now they’ll have a bit more to say than just oi… [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Advanced Adventure Sharing - The Sparkworks[/b][/h2][p]Players can now create their own gameplay in their worlds using the new logic system called “Sparkworks”. The possibilities range from simple interactions like light switches over dungeons with traps, puzzles, and even enemy encounters, to… well, we think the sky’s the limit. Why not try building a challenging parkour level, or battle arenas, escape rooms - or whatever else comes to YOUR mind![/p][p][/p][h2][b]The world was pretty before; now it shines![/b][/h2][p]A new rendering technology, the “brick renderer,” is now used to truly bring the vast open world to life. It significantly improves vistas by displaying a much higher level of detail for terrain and voxel buildings at a distance. Now, instead of turning into a pile of abstract blocks, that intricate castle you made will still look great from afar![/p][p]Each biome now feels more different and unique. The various areas have specific lighting, air moisture and sky atmosphere settings, strengthening the idea of exploring a living, breathing world. [/p][p]Numerous small changes, and some really big ones, have been added under the hood to achieve the impossible. The game runs at a good level of performance with less needed memory, while at the same time looking better than ever before. One example is the improved point light shadows - while predominantly a performance increase, this change allows the engine to render more point lights than previously, which will be especially noticeable in large player bases.[/p][p]We have also improved dynamic global illumination, which leads to, among other things, more vibrant colors in the Shroud and better lighting beneath large trees, in dense forests, and inside buildings. [/p][p]Also, HDR is now supported, if you have a monitor or TV that knows what to do with that.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]More spells, better spells, better combat, better players[/b][/h2][p]Let's start at the beginning: the completely new faction in Cinder’s Cradle brings 14 new enemy types, which with the enemy variants we’re adding to other factions, adds a total of 37 new faces roaring for a fight.[/p][p]Investments also went into making all enemies just a bit smarter, better at finding their way through our complex environments, and just feeling more convincing as adversaries.[/p][p]As for the players, while the changelog is full of many, many small and big improvements for all playstyles, the biggest combat focus of this update was the mage classes. We added 9 completely new types of spells to give mages more tools on the battlefield to handle challenging enemy encounters. This includes new crowd control spells, more area-of-effect damage, summons, and utility spells. Also, many additional tiers of existing spells have been created to broaden the options for mages at all stages of the progression.[/p][list][*][p]All spells now have eternal spell variations for the late game - eliminating the need to worry about running out of charges. Never again will you realize you're out of charges at the worst possible moment. Probably. [/p][/*][*][p]Eternal spells, and arrows, can now be upgraded just like weapons or other equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now actively summon skeletons to fight alongside them. They work for free, never complain, and only occasionally get in the way. This, combined with new “Necromancy” weapon gems and support skills, allows players to create an impressive amount of undead minions.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand gameplay has been expanded with a heavy attack that is immediately available, as well as unlockable evasive and aerial attacks as active skills. Also, wand gameplay has been improved with many small but significant fixes for selecting targets and general handling, including free aim.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous fixes, improvements and additional settings have been added for aiming with ranged weapons, allowing players to fine-tune the aim assist, enemy targeting, and much more.[/p][/*][*][p]Several new skills and improvements have been added to the skill tree. Thanks to community feedback and our own experience playing the game, the balancing of the skills and equipment continued, broadening the range of meaningful choices throughout every step of the progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Looking at the combat and movement of the player characters themselves, it was time to add the next layer of quality. We added many small animations to the player character to make turns, starts and stops in and out of running and sprinting more grounded and fluid, while keeping the reactivity and snappiness on the same level as in previous versions. At the same time, the camera has been improved with many, sometimes subtle tweaks and changes so that in the best case, you now completely forget that it even exists.[/p][/*][*][p]Traversal on steep slopes has been reworked to make the behavior more consistent and deliberate. At the same time, issues with involuntary sliding have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]A fresh start - Early Game Improvements[/b][/h2][p]We hope that with version 1.0.0.0, many new Flameborn climb out of that Cinder Vessel for the first time, ready to start exploring Embervale with fresh eyes. It was therefore a perfect opportunity for us to once more look at those first hours of the gameplay and work on the pacing, guidance and fun of getting to know the game’s features and challenges.[/p][p]We added more chests to the early game regions in Springlands and Revelwood to better reward exploration and also give players more opportunities to try out different gear and level up their weapons with more available runes and loot.[/p][p]Many roads and enemy camps have been touched up to reduce the chances of getting utterly lost in the open world and instead make players feel more in control of their journey.[/p][p]The recipes in the crafting progression have been reworked, especially in the early game. The goal was to reduce the grind and get players to the good stuff faster. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Player suggestions we included because hey that sounded like a good idea[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Shader compilation times after updates or GPU driver installations have been significantly reduced. Okay that one’s a trick we were always gonna improve it.[/p][/*][*][p]A new skill allows building in a free-flying mode. This makes it so much easier to build in hard-to-reach areas.[/p][/*][*][p]The boss in the Albaneve Summits has been reworked with a substantial nerf to its health, and with added opportunities to deal damage with melee weapons. Your twig collections will thank us. Also, the arena has been changed to make it easier for players to stay on solid ground or get back to it after jumping or being pushed over the ledge.[/p][/*][*][p]Scattered loot can now continuously be picked up in a larger radius. Either on demand by holding a button or automatically by sheer magnificence of being the Flameborn (by setting it so in the gameplay setting). Excluded from this is loot in containers, from enemies or special quest items.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now choose between the classic and the new, more realistic character proportions, either when creating a new character or by changing an existing one at the Barber. Perfect for those of you who weren’t so keen on hobbit roleplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Storage chests can now be upgraded. This can be done in place without having to empty them and pick them up first. Huge win for feng shui enthusiasts.[/p][/*][*][p]Updraft charge duration is now configurable in world settings, so if you preferred instant updraft, you can have your cake and eat it, too. [/p][/*][*][p]Custom map markers and chests can now be freely named. We know that some of you are VERY excited about this one.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing progression has been improved significantly; players can now hunt for specific fish by selecting the designated bait for each tier. Also, chances for higher quality fish have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]And so, so much more..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1] Changelog[/h1][h2]A public safety announcement[/h2][list][*][p]When playing for the first time in version 1.0.0.0 with an existing save game, the skill tree will be reset. Please make sure to spend the skill points again![/p][/*][/list][h2]World and Quests[/h2][list][*][p]The full game world is now accessible. Yes, all of it. Go touch all the new grass. This includes the new biome, Cinder’s Cradle, filling out the northern regions of the previously inaccessible areas of the map, but also new areas bordering the previous biomes and previously locked dungeons and areas. The area sits between Blackmire and Veilwater Basin in terms of size, and brings 12 new Shroud Roots.[/p][/*][*][p]All biomes but especially the Springlands, Blackmire and the Kindlewastes now have additional playable areas close to the edge of the world with new quests, new points of interest and 6 additional Shroud Roots. The overall density of points of interest is lower compared to areas on the critical path.[/p][/*][*][p]The gates to the Hollow Halls have now opened in the Albaneve Summits and Veilwater Basin. As always, beware - the Hollow Halls are best visited with dependable friends. [/p][/*][*][p]Most areas that were previously marked as no-build zones have been made fully accessible for player-built bases. This should allow for some interestingly placed player-built outposts. [/p][/*][*][p]Quests are now sorted into main quests for important progression steps or story elements and side quests for more optional exploration and loot.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the Albaneve Summit’s boss’s (that’s a lot of apostrophes!) lair include a wider walkable area, making it less likely to accidentally fall off the edges or get pushed over. Additionally, grapple hook anchors make it easier now to return to the walkable areas after getting pushed over the edge or gliding around the arena.[/p][/*][*][p]The Shroud covering parts of the boss’s lair has been lowered below the walkable area. There is already enough going on; the visual noise of the Shroud certainly did not help with keeping an eye on things. [/p][/*][*][p]Added numerous improvements to the shrouded areas all over Embervale. Especially in the Nomad Highlands it is now easier to find the way through the shrouded regions and potentially more importantly, out of the Shroud again. Additionally, 3 new save points have been placed in the Nomad Highlands Shroud.[/p][/*][*][p]Locked chests and doors on higher tiers now need a new set of lockpicks. Archaic lockpicks are starting in the new biome Cinder’s Cradle. Locks keep getting fancier, so your lockpicks had to as well. [/p][/*][*][p]Wooden chests now have a chance to contain a weapon or armor piece on the level of a silver chest. At the same time, the common tier loot has been removed from silver chest loot lists. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance for legendary items by +5% for all chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more loot chests to the Springlands and Revelwood. The goal is to reward exploration with open eyes and give players more equipment, specifically during the early game, to be able to better experiment with different weapons and try out upgrades for different pieces of gear. [/p][/*][*][p]Added gold coins to loot chests all over Embervale; it is now a resource requested by Survivors as exchange for several items, usually of the vanity kind. Even after the end of the world, the free market finds a way…[/p][/*][*][p]Linked to the change mentioned above, the gold coin material is now part of the Springlands material item set as it gets unlocked much earlier now.[/p][/*][*][p]The hourglass capsules are now appearing in many more places than before and, when used, add about 70% more time in the Shroud, giving players more strategic choices to plan their path moving out of the Shroud, or even deeper yet. [/p][/*][*][p]Hourglass capsules now also drop from large Fell foes to give players some time back in the Shroud after a lengthy battle. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the biome transitions to look more natural in some areas. The most noticeable change can be found between Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added small changes to points of interest and enemy camps all over Embervale to fix issues, make them prettier or to improve the gameplay. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the environments in Springlands, Revelwood, Blackmire and Nomad Highlands in regard to the topology, the look of the terrain and many props, the plants and the density of the forests. They were nice before, but even the prettiest biomes still deserve a glow-up. The tools for creating the world, and our vision for what makes Embervale exciting and interesting for combat and exploration, improved throughout the time in early access, so it was time to revisit the earliest areas and bring their quality closer to that of our more recent additions. [/p][/*][*][p]Some terrains or materials received a significant upgrade, such as the hardwood in the Revelwood tier. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some of the plants in Veilwater Basin to look a little bit more realistic. [/p][/*][*][p]Also improved the textures of materials and environment objects in the Shroud.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked numerous trees and bushes so that the harvesting method better fits their size. [/p][/*][*][p]Revisited some of the very old props from the early days of Enshrouded production and added detail and polishing where needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the enemy camps and encounters in the early game as necessary to make the early game progression feel smoother and more evenly paced.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with roads, such as weird bumps or slopes or unpolished textures. Also, especially in the early game, reworked the roads to provide better orientation to players who just started their journey and where stumbling into the wrong enemy camp could easily end very badly.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the first level-ups. Previously, walking into Longkeep often triggered a first level-up, which felt unsatisfying. The first level-up is now designed to happen when placing the first Flame Altar; this is not strict science, of course, as players are free to follow their own path. When following the quest line, the second level-up should then trigger when freeing the Blacksmith.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause a very high-level sword to drop in the first cave. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the quests to collect the wooden heads with new hairstyles so that they trigger more reliably.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where trash containers or piles didn’t have any loot.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some more hidden chests in various areas. Where, you ask? I guess you’ll have to find out…[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly tweaked the size of the stones on stone roads. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous small issues with waterfalls and lakes misbehaving. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a new quest and lore entries for the vanity outfit that was given out as part of the first-ever Twitch campaign. That was… an eternity ago, to be precise. [/p][/*][*][p]Air streams can now not only push gliding players vertically upwards, but also to the side, forwards, backwards or even downwards – basically any direction. The possibilities![/p][/*][*][p]Added lore journal entries hinting at the option to parry the projectiles of enemies back at them, in particular the ones from the Albaneve Summits’ boss. Also, added a journal entry that talks about their specific weaknesses.[/p][/*][*][p]Added rubble of several biomes to the corresponding terrain materials item sets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the quest “Vengeance” in the Veilwater Basin. It sometimes did not get resolved correctly when defeating another Drak'dal leader instead of the intended target. [/p][/*][*][p]Completely reworked the clouds on the horizon outside the playable area. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the ruins on various mountain tops now that buildings in the far distance have more visual details.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the eternal spell quest in the Veilwater Basin for additional eternal spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the course of the sun so that during sunset the areas behind the Albaneve Summits are not in shadow as long as before. Yes, we can literally move a star. Game devs have more power than our parents give us credit for.[/p][/*][*][p]The town Brittlebush has received visual polishing. Westcott was also reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a treasure chest in a level 30 night sanctum dropping level 1 loot. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some guidance issues in the Blood Rose quest. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a very large number of smaller level design issues such as buried entrances, difficult-to-climb ladders or floating props.[/p][/*][*][p]The yield of Archaic Essence from mining the corresponding terrains has been increased for all tiers.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the toughness of several mining materials, especially the materials that are important for larger settlements, such as stones, to help reduce some of the grindy parts of the gameplay. [/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned which spell charges are only available via crafting and which are found as loot in the world. As a rule of thumb, more versatile bread-and-butter spells can be found in the world as loot; more unusual spells for specific gameplay purposes are only available by crafting. This helps mages better organize the limited backpack space and only bring the spells that they really want to use.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the costs for opening chests by 25% in the end rooms of Hollow Halls to slightly reduce the need for resource grinding during a Hollow Hall run. Also added a tooltip to Hollow Hall journal entries and Bone Keys item details to make players aware that they should keep some resources to craft the key for the next Hollow Hall in the progression. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a silver chest into a suspicious-looking pile of rubble in the settlement Mark of Sameth.[/p][/*][*][p]Passion flowers and Saffron now grant more resources when picked.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of aquamarine ore nodes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with upstream visibilities. Unfortunately, in some lighting situations, the upstream effects can sometimes still be hard to see. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the tumbleweeds from the Nomad Highlands. May they rest in prickles. Don’t worry, they will be back once we solve some glitches and performance issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Added another layer of control to the scattering of roadside objects. Previously, they popped up in too many strange locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few cases where deadly, or simply too high-level Shroud encroached into areas where it shouldn’t. [/p][/*][*][p]Added more save points to the Blackmire spire to help in case the climb goes bad.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed outdated versions of the farmbeds from several farms in Embervale.[/p][/*][*][p]The quest to craft a Seafood Grill now starts after reaching Veilwater Basin and not before. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Enemies[/h2][list][*][p]Added numerous new enemy types to all existing enemy factions. Some are variations of existing enemies; others are completely new. All of them want to kill you.[/p][/*][*][p]All enemies now recover their health over time if players exit the combat area instead of resetting their health instantly. This new behavior will not make a drastic difference for regular enemies since their health bar is relatively small, but it makes a big difference when reattempting a boss after the whole party has been defeated. When re-engaging the boss in a timely fashion, some of its health will still not have fully recovered, giving the party an advantage in the next attempt. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the pathfinding for enemies that try to find the way home after chasing the players through unknown territories. They get scared when they get lost.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the line-of-sight checks for enemies to support better and more consistent decision-making. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several behavior issues for tamed enemies; for example, they no longer investigate noises from players - they just trust that everything is fine. [/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now actually search for players when they hear something instead of magically knowing where everyone is by looking into the current memory of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new phase to the Albaneve Summits boss where it stands on the playable area, exhausted. This allows melee-focused players to get in close for some devastating blows before the regular attacks continue. [/p][/*][*][p]The stun meter for the Albaneve Summits boss has been reworked. Before, the best and fastest method was to parry its projectiles back at it. This is still a powerful option, but using stun arrows or shock damage now works significantly better than before.[/p][/*][*][p]The air push attack of the Albaneve Summits boss pushes players more upwards than previously. This gives players more time to deploy the glider to get back safely. How nice of them![/p][/*][*][p]The weak point on the back of the Albaneve Summits boss now works as a regular weak point for all weapons; previously, it only worked as a weak point for arrows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Albaneve Summits boss that could cause the encounter to reset while players were still present in the area.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the flight curve of the Albaneve Summits boss projectiles. The projectiles can now also hit players standing very far away. You know who you are…[/p][/*][*][p]Added crafting resources to the loot of the vultures at the Albaneve Summits boss that help replenish stun arrows and lightning spells. [/p][/*][*][p]Added measures to prevent the Albaneve Summits boss from getting stuck in a stupor during the fight. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several animation and behavior glitches of the Albaneve Summits boss. Also improved the collisions for the main body and the legs and fixed issues with the target hard-lock for this enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies were staggered for too long after being hit by players. They now have the ability to counter-attack faster. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a check that makes sure tutorial enemies are always spawned, even when the enemy density is set to “few” in the world settings. [/p][/*][*][p]Further improved the enemy’s recognition of their height level versus their targets, specifically for melee enemies. They now better try to walk up or down or jump to reach their target. It might no longer be over if you have the high ground…[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues for hovering or swimming enemies to help them better control their positions relative to the ground. [/p][/*][*][p]Flying enemies now react as intended when attacked from very far away. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where flying enemies sometimes didn't have the correct loot when killed from far away. [/p][/*][*][p]Enemies should now better react and come to join the fight when their fellows are in active combat nearby. [/p][/*][*][p]Enemy damage susceptibilities have been reworked for a large number of enemies. The goal was to make enemies react to the damage type applied by the players more consistently depending on the faction but to also give individual enemies, especially elite and heavy class enemies, more personality.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked how the floating text "Resisted" or "Effective" is triggered over an enemy that just received a hit. Previously, both resisted and effective could easily be triggered at the same time by the same hit. To counter this, “Effective” is now only displayed, when an enemy is at least 20% susceptible to the used damage. Likewise, “Resisted” is now only displayed when the enemy is at 20% resistant to the used damage type.[/p][/*][*][p]Snapjaws in Veilwater Basin are now considered wildlife and not Drak.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Fell Fungal Friends that prevented them from scaling their health in accordance with party size in multiplayer. [/p][/*][*][p]Enemies no longer drop water pouches. It was a bit excessive…[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now have a chance to drop rings. [/p][/*][*][p]Added enemy head trophies for all heavy class enemies that did not yet have any, old and new. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved combat against vultures. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the damage of some of the Scavenger Matron attacks to bring it more in line with other nearby enemies. In particular, the poison area attack has been toned down. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the stamina costs for using the grappling hook to hook towards an enemy. [/p][/*][*][p]Toned down the damage from the Scavenger night patrols to about 60% of the previous damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly buffed the Reaping weapon perk. The stamina regeneration was previously too short to make a noticeable difference in combat. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a behavior issue with the Shroud Flayer’s Heart. It should now react correctly when attacked by players.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fell Confusion Pheromones now affect more Fell enemies. Fixed several cases of possible false positives and the jumps to the conflicts work more reliably now.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visibility settings for all HUD elements to give players the power to customize the optimal level of information versus immersion while playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Storage chests can now be freely named. We named ours Jeff.[/p][/*][*][p]Acquisition hints for resources are now also shown in the details menu of the resources. [/p][/*][*][p]Added acquisition hints to several resources that didn’t have one previously. [/p][/*][*][p]Browsing the various lists of the Adventure Sharing menu should now work more as expected with controllers. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several layout issues and improved navigation for the various adventure sharing menus. [/p][/*][*][p]Admins or hosts can now set the permission role of other players in the social menu at any time. When a player then leaves and rejoins the session, the previously set role is remembered for the next session. When players join a server, admins and hosts can see a message in the chat widget, informing of the joining and what the permission level of the newly joined player is. [/p][/*][*][p]Custom map markers can now be named freely. Note, custom map markers are only visible to the players themselves, not for other players. [/p][/*][*][p]Quests now show whether they are personal quests or world quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Quests are now classified as difficult when the target area and its enemies are 2 levels above the character level or more. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the layout of the factory menus to better show the resources available in magic chests. [/p][/*][*][p]The HUD now gives feedback when the focus bar is filled up but the player has not yet unlocked the special ability for the selected weapon or tool. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the hints in the equipment item detail screen for upgrading perks so that players can better understand which crafting survivor needs to be contacted. Also added a new icon for easier recognition.[/p][/*][*][p]The intro and outro slides can now be viewed in the journal once unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that, in item detail screens, such as for spell charges, some relevant damage, healing, or protection statistics were not shown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where buttons or toggles couldn’t be correctly used either by mouse clicks or controller button presses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several navigational issues in the journal, character and crafting menus - especially when playing with a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Added code to correctly handle the rare case when two equipment pieces are mapped to the same equipment slot. Players can now always unequip and re-equip the intended items. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several menu issues such as incorrect scrollbars.[/p][/*][*][p]All legal texts can now be viewed in the settings menu under the tab “Legal”. This is probably an exciting feature for a very specific kind of person.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the URLs for community links in some languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI issue when expanding all item set entries in the journal in save games with the maximum amount of progress. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with skill detail popups clipping out of the screen in the skill tree menu. [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted several default button or key mappings to account for newly added features. Please note that these updates made it necessary to reset custom bindings to the default for the update. Please check your settings before venturing out. [/p][/*][*][p]Added input bindings: Camera zoom in camera mode on controller (default is \[LB]+\[Right Stick] and Play/Pause Voice-Overs on keyboard (Default is the \[L]-key). Changed input binding: dropping torches is now by default on the \[R]-key on keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Saved worlds can now be sorted by last play time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where buff information in the HUD would flicker in certain situations. For example, the rested buff while in the player base.[/p][/*][*][p]Similar to the frost vignette, the low-health vignette intensity can now be configured in the game settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved several spell icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the acquisition hints in crafting resources to make more sense grammatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some incorrect acquisition hints of crafting resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all the typos… until we add new ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed the buff from the Shroud Survival Flask to Shroud Survival Flask.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some item icons, for example, the Archaic Essence icons for all tiers, the Chain Lightning, Shock Wisp, Shroud and Heal Beam and the Protective Barrier. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the description for the skillshot stat to better explain what it does.[/p][/*][*][p]Added spell crosshairs as needed for new spell types and new area-of-effect functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the values for the enemy damage slider in the server difficulty settings. It now better reflects the factual damage increase observed during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when salvaging gear in a storage chest while the backpack is completely filled up. Previously, this would cause the runes from the salvaging to simply disappear. Now, salvaging is not permitted in this situation.[/p][/*][*][p]The compass now correctly shows the direction of other players in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visuals of the compass and added finer markers to help with orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where the button prompt didn’t display the correct button. Such as cancelling fishing on controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Using the repair kit no longer triggers the message “All items repaired” as it’s not needed when using the repair kit and it is also somewhat misleading.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto sorting in inventories now also differentiates between arrow, spell charges and fishing bait. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the loot preview from wildlife corpses as it was not showing all loot but just one item. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a fix for a localization issue with the “Fire Aura” buff in the HUD. It should now be correctly translated into all languages.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Sound[/h2][list][*][p]Lore notes, letters and other texts found in the world are now narrated in English, German and Chinese. Other languages are planned for a later date. Now you can have lore beamed straight into your brain through your ears. The future is now.[/p][/*][*][p]For German enjoyers, the lore notes are narrated by Dietmar Wunder - the German voice of Daniel Craig.[/p][/*][*][p]A new widget gives players full control over the playback of the narrated journal entries. Tracks can be queued or played immediately, paused during combat, and much more. [/p][/*][*][p]The important crafting survivors and quest givers now have voice-over in English, German and Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p]Added improved sound reflections, reverb and environment detection to have sounds react more correctly to the shape of the dynamically changing terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a system that limits the amount of identical sounds that can be played at the same time. This helps reduce ugly sounds in areas with many traps, for example. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced spammy sounds in large enemy camps connected to the enemy alert states. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sounds continued to be played while the game was paused in single player. It should now be completely silent when paused. Finally, peace…[/p][/*][*][p]Added several new sounds to UI interactions and buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple small sound issues during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new system to dynamically lower the volume of certain sounds. This was required to keep the narrated lore notes audible while continuing with the gameplay. [/p][/*][/list][h2]General Visual Improvements [/h2][list][*][p]Thanks to a new rendering method called brick rendering, voxel terrain and buildings now have a much higher level of detail at large distances, drastically improving the look of vistas and far away points of interest. This should be especially noticeable in complex player builds.[/p][/*][*][p]Important props like trees can be seen at much further distances in player bases than before.[/p][/*][*][p]A more granular representation of the world, including props of a medium size and bigger, is now used to calculate the dynamic global illumination, resulting in an even more realistic real-time lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]The various biomes, day and night cycle and weather situations now have specific lighting settings, different air moisture and sky atmosphere settings, which helps convey the “feel” for each region much better.[/p][/*][*][p]Added height fog, depending on biome and day and night cycle, to increase the feeling of depth.[/p][/*][*][p]Added nice-looking Shroud clouds to the world outside the playable area.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the colorgrading and tonemapping to create a more natural and harmonic look of the whole game. [/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reworked the sun brightness levels to help improve the overall image quality. [/p][/*][*][p]The indirect lighting and colors are now more vibrant in shrouded areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the lighting below large trees and in dense forests. Previously, the areas below the canopies could be darker than one would expect.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the visuals of the intro slides. The voice-over is now switched to the lore narrator.[/p][/*][*][p]Added outro slides. [/p][/*][*][p]Props like trees, wooden bridges, etc. now correctly disable the display of raindrops below. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a flickering in the Shroud when viewed in the far distance “performance” graphical settings. Note, there can still be some shadow flickering in the distance on performance settings. This is being investigated and will be fixed in the future. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the range at which decorative elements are shown at building voxels.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the icon of Enshrouded. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Technical Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Implemented several methods to save video memory without sacrificing graphical quality. [/p][/*][*][p]Added several methods to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduced the VFX shader compilation time at the start of the game after updating the game or the GPU driver. A small amount of compilation time is unavoidable, however. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that led to visual effects and sound effects playing significantly delayed. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several graphical issues that could occur on very large and complex player bases. Shoutout to everyone who submitted their builds to us to check out via support and social media.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the point light shadows with the goal to support large player constructions with many lights. Point lighting impact on performance has been drastically reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the memory needed for server and client communication.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several measures to reduce the performance impact on CPUs. They’ve been working hard, and they deserve a break.[/p][/*][*][p]Enshrouded now supports HDR if a compatible monitor or TV has been connected. Also, a new calibration screen has been added to configure the HDR settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Switched to a new collision system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could prevent the game from starting due to a faulty search for connected microphones. Turns out the game was just trying to find someone to talk to.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause the soft or hard lock icons to stop working correctly during longer play sessions. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the behavior of cloth simulation, as well as other simulations such as hair and dangling elements on armor and enemies, while also improving the impact on performance. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the memory consumption and performance for the water simulation. [/p][/*][*][p]Added additional measures to try and load save data as best as possible even if corrupted data has been detected. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the list of graphics settings presets for the automatic GPU detection system. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the spawn sequence when starting with a fresh character to make sure the “pod”-sequence looks correct independent of how long the PC takes to load the necessary files. [/p][/*][*][p]Restored the wetness puddles during rainfall. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved responsiveness of player movement input while the server is under heavy performance load. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance on handheld devices, low-end graphics cards and the Steam Deck. [/p][/*][*][p]A server with low performance now has less impact on gliding. Previously, the overall flight path could depend on the server tick-rate. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Additional Quality of Life Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Holding the interaction button now collects all scattered loot in the vicinity of the player. This excludes loot in containers and defeated enemies, and quest-related items. A new setting allows players to automatically collect all such loot constantly without a button press.[/p][/*][*][p]The language for text can now be selected in the game settings.[/p][/*][*][p]At the same location, the newly added voice-over language can be selected.[/p][/*][*][p]The Shroud can now be pushed back with flame altars. You can finally show that fog who’s boss. To unlock this feature, the final flame level 11 has to be unlocked. Alternatively, the required flame level can be lowered to any level via the world settings. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the warning messages for server performance. Previously, the warnings could trigger too soon.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Save data[/h2][list][*][p]Enshrouded now uses a new save data format which results in smaller save game files and a simpler data structure in the save data folder. Basically, it’s better in every way.[/p][/*][*][p]When loading version 1.0 for the first time and the game detects a save game created with version 0.8 or earlier, the existing save data will be firstly backed up and secondly automatically migrated to the new format.[/p][/*][*][p]In the character selection menu and the world selection menu, players can now select if they want to use a local save game folder or the Steam cloud folder. This is organized in separate tabs, so make sure to select the correct tab if you don’t see the character or world that you expected to see.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now displays a warning that the save data can’t be overwritten for both the world save and the character save. This could happen if for some reason the save data is set to read-only in Windows. [/p][/*][*][p]The locally stored save data can now be found in this save data folder in Windows: C:\\Users\\WINDOWSUSER\\Saved Games\\keen games\\Enshrouded\\default[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's it for us for today! Come back tomorrow for the grand finale: our (very cool) Highlights video and the release! One day left!!![/p]

items.title: Enshrouded Launch FAQ: Early Access reward, world
items.contents:
Greetings Flameborn!

The finish line is in sight for us and there's a rush of activity from new and returning players, so we've put together this little FAQ for you!

[h3]When will 1.0 be available?[/h3]
A picture is worth a thousand words, so here's one thousand words:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/e0d2d238c6dae0c3a765aad76e21ce722ce57132.png[/img]

[h3]Will there be a trailer or an update highlights video?[/h3]
We have a trailer dropping [b]tomorrow[/b], and then the highlights video dropping on the day of release!

[h3]What's new in this update?[/h3]
A lot. We will publish the full changelog tomorrow, a whole day in advance of the release! We've also made a whole playlist of videos of new and improved things, so [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ur4YY4Bt8IU&list=PLdPsaoy6EOQk]check it out here[/url]!

[h3]I bought Enshrouded on PC in Early Access. Do I need to buy the game again for 1.0?[/h3]
You do not need to buy Enshrouded PC again if you own the Early Access version. 

[h3]Can I use my old saves from Early Access after release?[/h3]
You can absolutely use Early Access saves once the game releases in 1.0. Our save format is improving, so saves will be converted to a new, more efficient format. However, note that we have made many improvements to the world and first few hours of the game, so if you're up for it, we strongly encourage you to start over!

[h3]Will the game let me play with my friends on other platforms / will the game be cross-platforms?[/h3]
Enshrouded will not be cross-platform at launch, but we know many of your friendships have survived years of console wars. We are working on bringing cross-platform play to Enshrouded, but have no current estimate on how much time it will take us.

[h3]Are there rewards for getting the game in Early Access?[/h3]
We don't generally like FOMO, which is why all our Twitch drops can be found in-game. Having said that, we felt like our Early Access players deserved a [i]little[/i] something for betting on Enshrouded. There are three decorative props for your base that are exclusive to our Early Access players, redeemable from the "Redeem Add-Ons" button in the escape menu! If you get the game after the Early Access, you can ask an OG player to drop by your world and place it for you. You'll be able to remove it, just not place it down yourself. They can claim the items multiple times so there's no reason not to share! It even looks a little bit like a black metal album cover if you place a few down...

Check out what they look like!

Here's a statue which for reference is over 4 meters high and will look great in your base:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/c83e5246d3f0e0a4df8054093e019d43efed53db.png[/img]

Here's a tome with the might "E" that was our Early Access logo for over two years:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/2cc58dc4fb58f253cc0acead5e93ec9b3d0d54b8.png[/img]

And finally, here's the signal you turn on when you need a hero...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/6a57f368e6e78abe23ee61cebc2479c27c3442ed.png[/img]
(note that due to vfx transparency, the in-game look is slightly different.)



The release is so close, we can almost feel it... See you tomorrow for the trailer and changelog!

items.title: Turn your build into an adventure with Sparkworks!
items.contents:
Greetings, Flameborn!

We're very proud to be introducing Sparkworks, Enshrouded's brand new logic system, coming to the game with 1.0!

What's a logic system? It's a way to connect inputs, like pulling a lever, stepping on a pressure plate, etc, with an output, such as a door opens, a trap opens underfoot... The sky's the limit, the world is your oyster, the metaphors are running out. So just watch the cool video we made to introduce Sparkworks. Hope you like it!

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ur4YY4Bt8IU?si=lKHuUorxhhIo7sJ_"][/dynamiclink]


That's it for Sparkworks and for us today. We hope you're excited and if you are not, just think what would happen if you replaced the bridge in your base by trapdoors activated when stepping on the bridge, and just didn't tell your friends... Don't tell them we told you to do that.

One week to go before release. Highlights video next Thursday. It's happening!!

items.title: 1.0 Combat: changes and additions
items.contents:
[p]Greetings Flameborn!  [/p][p] [/p][p]Let’s cut right to the chase: mages in Enshrouded could do with a little bit of love. When we shipped[url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1203620/announcements/detail/534380184755767478"] combat changes[/url] in our last update, it was knowing we’d come back for mages at a later point. And the future is now, old man, so let’s dive in!  [/p][p]  [/p][h2]Mage gameplay improvements  [/h2][p]We are bringing some much-needed variety to the mystic classes, by adding a variety of new spells as well as increasing the level range in which these spells are useful, and reworking enemy weaknesses.  [/p][p] [/p][p]There are a total of 9 new spells coming to Embervale, adding utility and crowd control as well as damage, with powerful area of effect spells and even a new category of spells, summons! Here’s the roster of new stuff:  [/p][list][*][p]Mana Drain [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Entangle  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Pillar of Flames [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Blizzard  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ball Lightning  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Fire Totem [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Ice Totem [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Shock Totem [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Hollow Skeleton  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Here's a couple of them in action:  [/p][p][video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/365828028f322d3c0598e01b9bd2de19.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video][video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/315b0243ba2a740c8fb537dd9350121f.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"][/video][video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/612b2a6f8972f911fe6e4d6e41c0da50.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"][/video][/p][p]We know many of you love the necromancy part of the tree so we threw some friendly faces in there for the more macabre-minded among you. Maybe one of them is[url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o1SZDEa_KrA"] Kyle[/url]! We’re also adding two skills to the skill tree to increase the amounts of summonable skeletons and totems, in case you want the whole gang with you.  [/p][p]The Entangle spell should also help dealing with tougher enemies, and the two new AoE spells, Blizzard and Ball Lightning, with groups of enemies!   [/p][p]Also Mana Drain, which saps enemies of a fixed amount of mana per second to add it to your pool.  [/p][p]Existing and new spells will now get more versions, so that you can keep using your favorite spell combination from previous biomes as you progress through Embervale! [/p][p]There are now 22 tier 7 spell versions, which are the Eternal version of the spell. Eternal spells are the versions that do not consume spell ammo to be cast. Note that Eternal spells can also now be upgraded like weapons and armor, with unique new perks, such as reduced mana cost, etc.  [/p][p]Spell mana costs and casting times have been reworked to be balanced around their damage output and general usability. If you’re about to unleash a nuke, it’s gonna take more than a snap of the fingers, but in the meantime, here’s a quick spell to the face. Pocket sand!  [/p][p]  [/p][h2]Wand combat improvements  [/h2][p]We are also reworking wands to offer a heavy attack. Heavy attacks now pierce enemies, meaning that you can hit beyond the first bad guy. They also interrupt attacks on weaker enemies! On top of that, we’re adding to new wand skills: [/p][list][*][p]Aerial Wand Attack: can be triggered in mid-air and is an AoE for wands [video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/b374881564b9eed6c1d83cb73bfa02de.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video]
[/p][/list][p][list][*][p]Wand Evasion Attack: adds more flow to wand gameplay, and has wider, piercing projectiles. [video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/4f1915d80b81a1d955e3b3ac4b698d80.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video][/p][/*][p]Wand targeting (soft lock and hard lock) is improved. The settings are different for ranged weapons and melee, and now prioritize the center of the screen as well as enemies closer to you. This should increase the reliability and predictability of targeting.  [/p][p]We’ve also included numerous fixes for switching between wand and staff during combat.  [/p][p]Finally, you can now target explosive barrels with wands, which should delight the bad friends and chaos gremlins among you.  [/p][p] [/p][h2]New skills for mages & archers [/h2][p]Here are all the new skills for mages: [/p][list][*][p]Aerial Wand Attack (see above) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Wand Evasion Attack (see above) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Advanced Necromancy (more skeletons!) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Totem Mastery (more totems!) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Blast and Cast (After a critical strike with a wand, the base damage of your next staff attack within 10 seconds is increased by 50%) [/p][/*][/list][p]That last one should also help mage players pull out some interesting combos by switching between weapon types when the opportunity arises. [/p][p] [/p][p]While we think archers were in a better spot than mages, we don’t want them to feel left out by the attention other classes have received, so we’re adding a couple of skills to their arsenal: [/p][list][*][p]Puncture (Ranged piercing damage is increased by x%) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Barrage (Dealing damage with Bows has a x% chance to restore 1 durability to that weapon) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Survival Instinct (Defeating a Shroud-infested enemy with a bow or dagger restores x sec of time in the Shroud) [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]In addition to these new skills, we’ve also made changes based on community feedback, such as moved skills, reduced costs, buffed effects, etc. [/p][p]Finally, there are new aim assist options for ranged combat, which can be set in the game settings. Aim assist is enabled by default for controller, and disabled by default for mouse & keyboard. [/p][p] [/p][h2]New Eternal arrows [/h2][p]All Eternal arrows are also upgradeable, like weapons and now spells, also with perks! We’ve also added three new Eternal arrows for your eternal shooting needs: [/p][list][*][p]Eternal Fire arrow [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Eternal Shock arrow [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Eternal Bone arrow [/p][/*][/list][p]  [/p][h2]Player movement improvements  [/h2][p]We are bringing many additional animation and movement fixes, with the aim of making the player characters move in a more realistic fashion, while retaining agility and responsiveness.  [/p][p] [/p][p] [video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/6ed7eaf2babfa18010024e55fbecab1e.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video][/p][p][h2]Enemy variety  [/h2][p]The family is getting bigger, with all enemy factions, such as the Fell and Scavengers, getting a bunch of new enemy variants to keep encounters fresh. Some of these are heavy or elite level, so be on your guard when exploring the world. Better safe than sorry! [/p][p]  [/p][h2]New level cap  [/h2][p]New biome means new enemy tier and max level, for players and gear! Max player level cap is now 50, with a cap for equipment at level 55, and a whole host of new stuff for you to find.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Final thing to note: with the new skills and changes to existing skill placement in the tree, your skill tree has been reset, hopefully for the last time. [b]Don’t step out of your base without investing your points[/b], or you’re gonna have a bad time. [/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for our overview of combat changes for 1.0! We hope you are excited to try out the new stuff, and if you’re keen on playing a mage character when the game releases out of Early Access on October 15th, let us know![/p][p][/p][p]The team at Keen Games[/p][p] [/p]

items.title: Now's the best time to get Enshrouded!
items.contents: [p]Hi Flameborn![/p][p][/p][p]Two important piece of news for you today:[/p][olist][*][p]The price of Enshrouded is increasing by €10, to €39.99 (or the equivalent in your denomination of choice) on September 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Until then, the game is the cheapest it's ever been at €22,49 (ǝɔᴉoɥɔ ɟo uoᴉʇɐuᴉɯouǝp ɹnoʎ uᴉ ʇuǝlɐʌᴉnbǝ ǝɥʇ ɹo) as part of Steam's PVE Survival Crafting Fest.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]Why is the price of Enshrouded increasing?[/h3][p]Simply put, over the course of its Early Access, Enshrouded has grown and improved immensely, both in terms of features and content. We've always planned to increase the price once early access ends (it's in our Early Access FAQ!), and more importantly, this will allow us to keep developing the game further, for as long as possible.[/p][p][/p][h3]I was going to wait for 1.0. Should I get the game now?[/h3][p]If you want to enjoy a significant discount over the release price, now is a great time to get the game! Between the price increase and the discount, this means that right now, you can pick up Enshrouded for €22.49, which is almost €17.50 cheaper than the release price! But if you're not sure and you would rather wait and see on release, that's fine by us and it's an entirely reasonable course of action.[/p][p][/p][h3]I already own the game, why are you telling me this?[/h3][p]We have a detailed model of our player community and our estimates tell us that most of you know at least one (1) other person. That person in turn may be interested in getting Enshrouded on the cheap, especially before the price increase.[/p][p][/p][h3]Incorrect. I do not know anyone, actually.[/h3][p]And yet you've read this whole thing? Then we tip our hats to you, you make writing blogs about price increase and discounts worth it. [/p]
items.author: CoolUsernameBro

items.title: We're still cooking for 1.0. Here's some news you may have missed!
items.contents: [p]Hi Flameborn![/p][p][/p][p]Our October 15th release date is almost close enough to touch, being a little over 6 weeks away, so we've started sharing some of the changes we're making to Enshrouded. For now, we're focusing on [i]existing stuff[/i], and how we're improving features and systems that are already in the game. The improvements mentioned in the following video are just some of the bigger changes we're making, with a much longer list waiting for you in the Highlights video (and the release changelog) in October![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WZBpAILoao4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The other big challenge we're tackling for 1.0 is making Enshrouded's performance better, after years of adding systems, details, making the thing more beautiful, etc. We really wanted to get the game to perform much better including on lower and middle-range systems, especially because someone keeps adding forests full of bamboo to the game for some reason!! Joke aside, this is our second ever look behind the scenes, and we hope you'll enjoy to learn about the nuts and bolts of what makes Enshrouded tick, and what magic is at work behind the curtains.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4AQycxtpPno;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We have more videos coming out in a few weeks, although currently part of the team is at Gamescom, demoing some of the upcoming changes to the games press, as well as the PS5 version. Beyond that, September is going to be ripe with dozens of cool games coming out, so we're sure you'll have something to stay busy until the next video... [/p][p][/p][p]Let us know your thoughts about what you saw, and if you liked this type of behind the scenes footage, let us know what else you'd like to learn more about![/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p]The team at Keen Games[/p]

In the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1203620/eventcomments/568164159307512976?snr=2_groups_partnerevents_&ctp=2#c568164159307521831"]comments thread[/url] over on our Steam forum relaying the announcement, you'll find mention of a lot of the stuff we're working on: optimization, performance, QoL changes, the dragon boss fight... if you think it could be better there's a good chance that we're working on it, and that it's mentioned by one of our devs in the comments![/p][p][/p][p]More news in August. Until then, stay hydrated![/p]

items.title: Enshrouded - 1.0 Release Date Reveal
items.contents: [p]Hey Flameborn![/p][p][/p][p]Today is a big day for us as we are finally able to reveal the [b]release date for Enshrouded 1.0[/b]! No padding to the announcement, there's one video we want you to check out, here it is![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/_6atVNfcECU?si=qUxXy40_nrzby4FJ"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Can't watch the video right now? That's okay, the important information is [b]Enshrouded releases out of Early Access on Steam on October 15th![/b] And if you want a peek at some of the many things that are coming with the update, you'll have to take a look at the video...[/p][p][/p][p]We will bring you more news about improvements, optimization, QoL changes, as well as all the new stuff, later this summer! items.title: Enshrouded: Forging the Path Livestream
items.contents:
[p]Early Access is available for purchase now! Thank you to [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@TotalXclipse"][/dynamiclink] for the footage, we hope you enjoy the new update as much he did! 

You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival Action RPG for up to 16 players.  Here we are with our sixth update! We’re thrilled to bring you Thralls of Twilight, a new update designed to make the Shroud more inviting and more dangerous than ever, adding some new gameplay mechanics, as well as a huge number of new locations to explore, and a bunch of gameplay improvements and additions. We've also updated a slew of locations and points of interest across the world, and as always, a bunch of miscellaneous other fixes and improvements![/p]

items.title: Crimson Desert Original Soundtrack Volume 2 Has Arrived
items.contents: [p align="center"]The second official soundtrack for Crimson Desert, capturing the atmosphere of the vast open-world of Pywel, is now available. [/p][p align="center"]Featuring 42 tracks, the album focuses on a more dramatic narrative and an even richer melodic sound. It spans a wide range of vocal pieces, from tranquil, lyrical field themes and sweeping anthems to sea shanties that reimagine traditional Korean folk songs and children’s songs passed down through oral tradition in a Western style, as well as songs of bards. Thrilling combat and boss battle themes, along with expansive soundscapes, complete Pywel’s one-of-a-kind musical world.[/p][p align="center"] [/p][p][b]STREAM IT ON:[/b][/p][p][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/3xBqRAc33PNlIQPDPxfCXJ"]\[[/url][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/4xYW6yBfCyQ1TnGITwQkSy?si=sOiPzNiVQkCCbnvDLWVg0w&utm_source=copy-link"]Spotify[/url][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/3xBqRAc33PNlIQPDPxfCXJ"]] [/url][url="https://music.apple.com/album/crimson-desert-original-soundtrack-volume-2/6831033900"]\[Apple Music] [/url][url="https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_n4UKCjiUyMljQThL0cQU31cjNaAc2T0jk&si=lNDvbjNb-H9HG4L9"]\[YouTube Music][/url][/p][p][/p][p][b](COMING SOON) AVAILABLE FOR FREE ON:[/b] [/p][p]\[STEAM][/p][p][/p][p align="center"]   You can also listen to the album in full on the Pearl Abyss Music YouTube channel.[/p][p align="center"] [/p][p align="center"][img src="https://s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/brand/board/2026/11/09/ae897143a6020261109062946913.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="center"][url="https://youtu.be/RtOVF8R8SkY"]\[LINK][/url][/p]
