items.title: Patch Notes Version 2.04.00
items.contents:
[p][img src="https://s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/brand/board/2026/10/29/1f9045111ac20261029120115510.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Charting the Unknown[/h3][h1]Reach Beyond, Into the Unknown[/h1][p]Hello Greymanes,
Crimson Desert: Enhanced's DLC 'Charting the Unknown' is finally here.
From uncharted islands beyond the sea to the ocean’s depths, explore Pywel to your heart’s content.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Update Schedule[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]The patch is rolling out across all platforms.
Please refer to the Update section below to see the state of the patch for each platform.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Update[/b][/p][p]Steam (PC): Patch available now
Steam (Mac): Patch available now[/p][p] [/p][p]* Due to technical adjustments applied to the Mac build, this patch requires a one-time download of the full-size game package for players on Steam (Mac) and the Mac App Store. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p] [/p][h1]Patch Details[/h1][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2]The Journey Continues[/h2][p][img src="https://s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/brand/board/2026/10/29/1775e6f474d20261029120259041.png"][/img][/p][p]New stories unfold across Pywel—from an ominous presence in the desert and a dangerous political conflict to a journey beyond time and an ancient secret beneath the waves. Follow Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane as they forge their own paths forward, discover their purpose, and shape their destinies.[/p][list][*][p][b]One individual quest each has been added for Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane.[/b][/p][list][*][p]The new quests can be found from the "Journal" menu, after completing "Journey's End" from the main story.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Explore the Ocean[/h2][p][img src="https://static.pearlcdn.com/asset/brand/cd/contents_cd/img/game/charting_the_unknown/dlc_content_2_1.webp"][/img][/p][p]Adventure now extends beyond Pywel's shores.
Take command of your ship and set sail across the ocean to explore new islands off the coast. Then dive beneath the waves to uncover underwater treasures, sunken ruins, and hidden mysteries.[/p][list][*][p][b]The ocean is now yours to explore.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new quest, "A Wider World", that centers around the ocean.[/p][list][*][p]The quest will begin after completing "Howling HIll" from the main story and by expanding your Greymane camp above a certain level.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a gauge for your breath, allowing you to dive underwater.[/p][list][*][p]The higher your breath capacity, the longer you can stay underwater.[/p][/*][*][p]You can increase your maximum breath capacity by refining your diving suit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added food items that temporarily restores breath.[/p][/*][*][p]Added equipment that allows the A.T.A.G to operate underwater when equipped.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added "ships" as a new mount.[/p][list][*][p]Ships can be constructed through a dispatch mission, or purchased from fleetmasters located throughout Pywel.[/p][list][*][p]Ships can also be customized using parts purchased from fleetmasters in Demeniss and Delesyia.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]You can use your ship for maritime trading, and new trade goods have been added for these trades.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added various new underwater mounts.[/p][list][*][p]Depending on their type, underwater mounts can be subdued or fed to increase their Trust. Once their Trust is high enough, they can be resitered as mounts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added several uncharted islands, which you can pioneer by taking on new missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added multiple treasure maps that lets you search for hidden treasures scattered throughout the world.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]A Richer Life in Pywel[/h2][p][img src="https://static.pearlcdn.com/asset/brand/cd/contents_cd/img/game/charting_the_unknown/dlc_content_3_2.webp"][/img][/p][p]Make your mark on Pywel in more ways than ever before.
Rent and manage a variety of facilities to earn your fortune, build a home that's truly your own with the upgraded Housing mode, and talk with the people of Pywel to forge deeper bonds.[/p][list][*][p][b]Added an expanded housing system.[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can use the upgraded housing system by completing Luke's Request, one of the Greymane Faction quests under "Grounds of the Sunrise", and after setting up the camp in Howling Hill.[/p][/*][*][p]You can design and build your home's layout to your liking, and place various structural elements such as walls and windows yourself.[/p][/*][*][p]This can be accessed by selecting Home Decoration > Layout > Free Construction.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added two castles that you can decorate.[/b][/p][list][*][p](Spoiler)[/p][/*][/list][expand][list][*][p]Drakesfall Castle[/p][list][*][p]Awarded after completing "Journey's End" from the main story and by liberating the stronghold.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Flame Knight's Castle[/p][list][*][p]Awarded after completing Damiane's quest "Politician" and by liberating the stronghold.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/expand][/*][*][p][b]Improved the map so that strongholds owned by the Greymanes now appear in light blue.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a management content that allows you to manage and operate liberated strongholds.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a "Facilities" tab on the map that allows you to access information related to management facilities.[/p][/*][*][p]You can rent a stronghold to operate and manage a restaurant, sawmill, smithy, or tailor's shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Added rewards that can be acquired by completing the management content.[/p][/*][*][p]Management facilities will continue to operate even when you're away from them.[/p][/*][*][p]Special guests may visit facilities that are being managed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added a mission that allows you to hold festivals at camp.[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs with whom you have reached a certain level of trust will visit the camp for the festival, which lasts for a limited time.[/p][/*][*][p]Interacting with the NPCS at festivals allows you to build trust with them more quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain visitors can be hired as "Honorary Greymanes".[/p][list][*][p]Honorary Greymanes can be sent out on dispatch missions like your other comrades, but some features may be unavailable to them.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added an additional level of "Trust".[/b][/p][list][*][p]Select "Interact" > "Flirt" to build continue increasing the additional level of trust with other NPCs, and once that level of trust reaches 100, you can propose to them.[/p][list][*][p]Select "Flirt", then "Gift" or "Chat" to continue building trust.  The additional level of trust can only be increased once a day for each type of interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]If you "Flirt" with a certain NPC as one playable character, their trust with the other playable characters will decrease.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Some NPCs may require special conditions to be met.[/p][list][*][p](Spoiler)[/p][/*][/list][expand][list][*][p]Witches: Complete each witch's sanctum quest[/p][/*][/list][/expand][/*][*][p]A feature has been added that lets you change your spouse's appearance at barber shops.[/p][/*][*][p]After marriage, your spouse's icon will appear on the world map and minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]You can travel together with your spouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Your spouse may also give you gifts from time to time.[/p][/*][*][p]After marriage, you can also break up with your spouse, but doing so comes at a cost.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added a total of 17 residences.[/b][/p][list][*][p]This residence can be built through dispatch missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Once you designate a residence, your spouse will live there.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the map to display the icon of the residence's owner among Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added a new minigame, "Banker's Dice".[/b][/p][list][*][p]"Banker's Dice" can be played in Demeniss and Delesyia.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]New Threats Emerge[/h2][p][img src="https://static.pearlcdn.com/asset/brand/cd/contents_cd/img/game/charting_the_unknown/dlc_content_1_1.webp"][/img][/p][p]Formidable foes await across land and sea, each bringing new dangers to overcome.
Adapt your tactics, and steel yourself for your fiercest battles yet.[/p][list][*][p][b]Added a new combat content: "Garden of Trials".[/b][/p][list][*][p]"Garden of Trials" becomes available after completing "Journey's End" from the main story, and features a total of 10 groups to challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]You can challenge "Garden of Trials" with a comrade that you have entered together, or alone.[/p][list][*][p]You can challenge it with maximum of three characters; Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane.[/p][/*][*][p]You can choose the order in which the characters enter the battle.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]In the "Garden of Trials", food items cannot be used for recovery.[/p][/*][*][p]If a character is defeated during combat, the next character in order will continue the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing each group enhances one of your existing skills.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Garden of Trials" is located near the Axiom Archive Abyss.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added new equipment.[/b][/p][list][*][p]The additions include armor, weapons, mounts/pet equipment, Abyss gear, and various other equipment.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added several powerful bosses, and some of them are available for a rematch using Memory Fragments.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added the "Relic Collector" NPC, who exchanges relics obtained through exploration for various items.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]New Additions[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Save files created while the DLC is installed cannot be loaded or used for cross-save in a game version that does not include the DLC.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the NPC interaction UI.[/p][list][*][p]You can now 'Chat' and 'Gift.' with other NPCs.[/p][list][*][p]You can perform ordinary interactions through 'Interact.'[/p][/*][*][p]Through 'Chat,' you can share your Knowledge with NPCs and earn their trust.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new books that will help you learn residents' preferences.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]After performing an interaction that raises trust with an NPC, the wait time (cooldown) until the same interaction can raise trust again will be displayed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a dedicated storage box for insects, making it easier to manage and collect insects.[/p][list][*][p]Three new legendary insects and sighting reports have been items.title: Charting the Unknown DLC Features Overview
items.contents:
[p]Greetings, Greymanes!

As the release of Charting the Unknown approaches on October 29 GMT/PT, a new Features Overview video offers a sneak peek at some of the new adventures waiting in the upcoming DLC.

Watch the video, then read on to learn more about how you can prepare for Charting the Unknown’s main content.
[/p][p][img src="https://private-s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/alpha/brand/board/2026/10/20/8119c3d830120261020122601179.jpg" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-family: StrongSword_New, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; vertical-align: top; height: auto; max-width: 100%;"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Content Overview & Prerequisites
[/b]Some features in Charting the Unknown become available once certain prerequisites are met. Learn more below.  [/p][p][b]
New Stories 
[/b][/p][p]Charting the Unknown introduces three new storylines, one each for Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane. After completing the main story, these stories can be started through the Journal menu.
In addition, a new ocean-focused storyline will become available after completing "Howling Hill" from the main story. 

[b]Exploring the Ocean 
[/b]Charting the Unknown allows Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane to dive into the sea and explore the underwater world of Pywel. Below the waves, you’ll discover ruins, treasure chests, and new creatures and mounts.
No special conditions are required to dive underwater, but keep in mind that staying underwater consumes breath. You may want to prepare yourself with items or gear, such as a diving suit, to extend your time underwater.
You’ll be able to build your own ship and set sail across the Great Ocean of Pywel once you complete a related questline, which becomes available after you have set up your Greymane Camp at Howling Hill.
You can build a ship by sending your comrades on a ship-building dispatch mission at a port or purchase one from a Fleet Office manager. 

[b]Romance and Festivals 
[/b]With Charting the Unknown, Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane can form even deeper bonds with some of Pywel’s inhabitants. Interact with them to build trust and deepen your relationship, which may eventually blossom into romance and even marriage.
These connections also bring new life to the Greymane Camp: once it’s upgraded to a certain level, friends you’ve grown close to may visit and spend time with you, making the camp livelier than ever.  [/p][p][b]
Upgraded Housing System 
[/b]An upgraded housing system will be available in Charting the Unknown which will let you build your house from the ground up.
Once you’ve set up your camp in Howling Hill and completed Luke’s Request under the “Grounds of the Sunrise” Greymanes Faction quest, you’ll have access to both the regular and upgraded housing system.  

[b]Greymane Castles 
[/b]In Charting the Unknown, three specific castles are available for you to claim. Complete the main story and relevant quests, then liberate each stronghold to unlock missions that let you claim the castles as your own, allowing you to decorate the courtyards and interiors with unique objects and furnishings. 

[b]Management
[/b]Rent and manage different businesses, from a restaurant in Vellua to a smithy at Zargan Tankworks. You can access various facilities across Pywel from the world map once you’ve completed the faction quest required to liberate the relevant region and have completed setting up your Greymane Camp.  

[b]Garden of Trials 
[/b]Charting the Unknown introduces Garden of Trials, a new combat-focused content where you face off against bosses you've encountered throughout your adventures in Pywel, one after another. Garden of Trials can be accessed after clearing the main questline, and completing this challenge will grant you special rewards. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope the Features Overview video and the information above have been helpful in preparing you for the new adventures that await in Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown. Additional details will also be shared via patch notes on the day of release.   We look forward to seeing you in Pywel.  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5001840/Crimson_Desert_Enhanced_Charting_the_Unknown/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]
Charting the Unknown Release Times by Region:[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][b]Europe[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]North America[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Asia[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]October 29th, 2026 (Thu) at 22:00 (UTC)

items.title: Charting the Unknown: Release Date Update
items.contents:
[p]Hello Greymanes,[/p][p]We are hard at work on Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown to bring you new adventures to Pywel.
[/p][p]However, we have determined that we need additional development time to deliver a more polished and stable gameplay experience.
Therefore, we have decided to move the DLC's release by 2 weeks to [b]October 29 GMT/PT[/b].
[/p][p]We know many of you have been looking forward to returning to the game and we sincerely apologize for the longer wait.
We will use the additional time to further refine the content and do our utmost to deliver the best experience we can.
[/p][p]We look forward to seeing you in Pywel on October 29 GMT/PT.[/p][p]
